Appendix A. Formal Mathematical Proofs of Governance Safety and Idempotency Invariants

Theorem A.1 (Safety & Mutual Exclusion of the Layer 1 Scheduling Gate Gplan):
Let S = (e, o, fstop, frun, tnow, J) be any operational state tuple presented to Algorithm 1 (planRun), and let LOS(p, acctp) be the OS-level process lock in Layer 3 (process_lock.py). Then no two concurrent agent processes P1 and P2 can simultaneously mutate the same platform account state, nor can any unauthorized or future-scheduled job enter the execution queue.

Proof. By construction of Equation (1) and Algorithm 1, planRun evaluates three ordered preconditions prior to inspecting J: (i) if e = ∅ ∨ e ≠ o, it returns (skip, not_owner, ∅); (ii) if fstop = true, it returns (skip, stop_flag, ∅); and (iii) if frun = true, it returns (skip, already_running, ∅). For any job jk ∈ J, admission into the due set D requires donek = false ∧ authk = true ∧ tdue,k ≤ tnow. Thus, no unapproved (authk ≠ true) or premature (tdue,k > tnow) job can be returned in D. Furthermore, even if two OS processes P1 and P2 invoke Layer 3 simultaneously with valid owner credentials, AcquireProcessLock(p, acct_p) requests an exclusive atomic OS file/PID lock tied to (p, acctp). A stale lock is recovered if and only if the OS kernel process table confirms that the holding PID has terminated. Hence, at most one process can enter the critical section for (p, acctp) at any time t. ■
Theorem A.2 (Zero-Duplicate Submission under Arbitrary Post-Commit Network or UI Timeouts):
Suppose a platform adapter in Layer 3 executes Algorithm 2 for release plan P on platform p. If the final commit action (Line 10, DispatchSingleFinalCommit) is invoked at least once, then no subsequent timeout, network drop, DOM selector failure, or repeated invocation of vpub publish can trigger a second commit click for plan P.

Proof. In Algorithm 2, Line 9 executes R_p.f_submit ← true and PersistAtomically(R_p) strictly prior to Line 10 (DispatchSingleFinalCommit). Suppose the external platform accepts the submission at Line 10, but the confirmation wait or read-back at Line 11 times out (as observed empirically on Douyin in Table 6 or during the 380.551 s window on Instagram in Table 7). Execution enters the else branch at Line 14, setting R_p.σ_p ← UNKNOWN_LATCHED while preserving R_p.f_submit = true on disk. Now consider any subsequent retry invocation of Algorithm 2 (either by an automated cron agent or a CLI retry loop). After acquiring the process lock at Line 2, Line 3 evaluates the guard if R_p.f_submit = true. Because f_submit was atomically latched to true prior to the first commit, Line 4 immediately returns ReconcileExistingReceipt(R_p), which invokes read-only verification (vpub verify) and never reaches Line 10. Therefore, the total number of external commit dispatches is bounded above by 1. ■
Theorem A.3 (Preservation of Live Work Identity under Revision and Deletion Faults):
Under Algorithm 3 (Layer 4), neither a missing platform edit control nor an unverified deletion request can destructively overwrite an existing work ID or delete an adjacent work.

Proof. In VERIFY_ONLY or APPLY_EDIT mode, Line 1 verifies account identity, and Line 3 reads the native editor metadata. If live metadata already equals ΔP.target_meta, Line 4 terminates without issuing a save click. If p = X and native edit controls are absent (Line 6), Line 7 aborts with MISSING_EDIT_ACCESS_NO_DELETE_OR_REPOST; no fallback path exists to delete or re-upload the post. In DELETE_WORK mode, Line 12 requires a durable consent token Cdel cryptographically bound to R_p.wid_p and R_p.H_media, and Line 14 refreshes the remote catalog to verify both the absence of R_p.wid_p and the preservation of neighboring work IDs. ■

Appendix G. Complete Laboratory Research Protocols & Multi-Modal Quality Engineering Documentation

This appendix archives the complete technical protocol documentation from agentic-work-lab/docs/ governing programmable video synthesis, animation timing diagnostics, temporal quality checks, and epistemic hygiene.

G.1 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/animation-timing.md

# 動畫節奏研究

**繁體中文** · [English](animation-timing_EN.md)

研究日期：**2026-10-26** · 整理：**2026-10-28**

## 結論

輸出幀率、同一張圖停留的時間，以及相鄰姿勢之間的位移是三件事。把輸出從 24 fps 改成 30 fps，並不會自動補出接觸、放手或撤回等缺失的動作。

| 24 fps 時間格 | 每個姿勢佔用幀數 | 每秒曝光段 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 一拍一 | 1 | 24 |
| 一拍二 | 2 | 12 |
| 一拍三 | 3 | 8 |

曝光段數不等於每秒新畫的獨立圖數；同一張圖可以重複使用。

CELSYS 的示例分別調整中間畫的間距和時間表，展示兩者如何改變速度與觀感。[原始教學](https://howto.clip-studio.com/library/page/view/retasstudio_anime2_00_005)。

Animation Mentor 的緩入／緩出教學可作為閱讀運動節奏的補充。[教學](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/slow-in-and-slow-out-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/)。

## 本地診斷結果

研究時檢視的版本為 66.7 秒、30 fps、2,001 幀。時間表含 52 個片段，其中 44 個是保持片段；保持時間中位數為 0.85 秒，最長為 7 秒。這些數字描述當時版本的時間安排，不是對所有作品的品質評分。

以「把碗放到桌上」為例，檢查順序是：靠近 → 接觸 → 短暫承重 → 放手 → 撤回。必須逐段確認手、碗和桌面的接觸點及遮擋關係。淡入淡出只能處理畫面交接，不能替代物體交接。

## 驗證邊界

此項成果是診斷方法、時間表分析與審片標準。原研究完成時，新的自然動作效果尚未驗收；後續影片與舊版實驗片的狀態請查看各自目錄，不能把方法完成寫成所有動作已修好。

G.2 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/animation-timing_EN.md

# Animation timing study

[繁體中文](animation-timing.md) · **English**

Study date: **2026-10-26** · Compiled: **2026-10-28**

## Findings

Output frame rate, the duration of an exposure, and displacement between poses are different quantities. Changing a render from 24 to 30 fps does not create missing contact, release, or withdrawal actions.

| 24 fps timebase | Frames per exposure | Exposures per second |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| On ones | 1 | 24 |
| On twos | 2 | 12 |
| On threes | 3 | 8 |

Exposure count is not the number of unique new drawings; drawings may be reused.

CELSYS demonstrates how changing in-between spacing and exposure timing affects motion. [Primary tutorial](https://howto.clip-studio.com/library/page/view/retasstudio_anime2_00_005).

Animation Mentor's slow-in/slow-out lesson provides additional context for reading motion. [Tutorial](https://www.animationmentor.com/blog/slow-in-and-slow-out-the-12-basic-principles-of-animation/).

## Local diagnostic result

The inspected version was 66.7 seconds at 30 fps, with 2,001 frames. Its timeline contained 52 segments, including 44 holds; the median hold was 0.85 seconds and the longest was 7 seconds. These numbers describe that version's timing, not a universal quality score.

For placing a bowl on a table, inspect: approach → contact → brief load transfer → release → withdrawal. Check the hand, bowl, table contact, and occlusion at each stage. A dissolve changes the image transition; it does not establish a physical handoff.

## Verification limits

The result is a diagnostic method, timeline analysis, and review criteria. At the original study cutoff, improved motion had not yet been accepted. Consult the catalogue for each later video or experimental cut; completing a method does not establish that every motion defect is fixed.

# 每小時營運驗證

**繁體中文** · [English](automation-verification_EN.md)

本頁記錄 **2026-10-28** 的一次真實排程驗證，不代表持續可用性保證。

| 事件 | 北京時間 |
| --- | --- |
| 預定觸發 | 12:37:13.943 |
| 實際開始 | 12:37:38.935 |
| 完成 | 12:38:10.110 |
| 觸發延遲 | 24.992 s |
| 執行時間 | 31.175 s |

日誌中的觸發來源是 `automation_heartbeat_scheduled`。核驗同時檢查了開始、完成及實際工具行為，沒有以設定為 ACTIVE 或模型自述作為成功證據，也沒有另開手動測試。

該輪讀取執行歸屬、停止條件、檢查表和進度；確認評論、互動元件、熱點研究與數據檢查尚未到期，並同步營運說明。沒有需要執行的 B站平台操作。

當時新實例以每 60 分鐘執行一次，舊實例的營運排程保持暫停。這是該時間點的核驗結果；後續狀態仍須查實際日誌。

## 可重用原則

- 每輪先確認唯一執行者、停止標誌和到期時間。
- 已開始但尚未完成時繼續觀察，不併發重跑。
- 將「已設定」「已觸發」「執行完成」「平台操作成功」分開記錄。
- 沒有到期事項時，正常完成不需要平台寫入。

自動壓縮另有設定與執行時閾值核對；當時尚未觀察到真正跨過閾值後的壓縮週期，因此不宣稱端到端壓縮已驗證。

G.4 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/automation-verification_EN.md

# Hourly operations verification

[繁體中文](automation-verification.md) · **English**

This page records one real scheduled-run verification on **2026-10-28**, not a continuous-availability guarantee.

| Event | UTC+8 |
| --- | --- |
| Scheduled | 12:37:13.943 |
| Actual start | 12:37:38.935 |
| Completed | 12:38:10.110 |
| Trigger delay | 24.992 s |
| Duration | 31.175 s |

The recorded trigger was `automation_heartbeat_scheduled`. Verification covered start, completion, and tool activity rather than relying on an ACTIVE setting or a model's self-report. No manual test run was launched.

The run read execution ownership, stop conditions, the checklist, and checkpoints. Comment, component, topic-research, and analytics work was not yet due; operational instructions were synchronized. No Bilibili platform operation was needed.

At that point, the destination instance ran every 60 minutes and the previous instance's schedules remained paused. This is a point-in-time finding; later health must be checked from actual records.

## Reusable principles

- Check the sole active operator, stop flag, and due time first.
- Observe an in-progress run rather than launching a duplicate.
- Record configured, triggered, completed, and platform-success states separately.
- A valid no-work-due run requires no platform writes.

Automatic compaction settings and the runtime threshold were checked separately. A real threshold-crossing compaction cycle had not been observed, so end-to-end compaction is not claimed as verified.

G.5 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/business-development.md

# AI 輔助資料研究：商戶示例

**繁體中文** · [English](business-development_EN.md)

## 從需求到可重用流程

把模糊需求拆成可執行流程，選擇工具，保留資料來源，檢查結果，再把可用的方法整理成團隊能複用的範本。B站專案提供真實的研究、內容交付、排程與數據紀錄；商戶拓展部分是將這套方法用於商戶資料整理的離線演示。

## 示例工作流程

| 日常工作 | AI 協助方式 | 人類決策與交付 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 商圈與商戶研究 | 整理公開來源、分類業態、標記缺失資料。 | 核對營業與服務範圍，形成一頁簡報。 |
| 線索排序 | 依明確欄位產生可解釋排序。 | 依地區策略與資源調整優先級。 |
| 溝通準備 | 起草價值主張、訪談問題和異議處理。 | 核對承諾與商戶情況，再決定如何聯絡。 |
| 會後整理 | 將會議筆記整理成需求、承諾、負責人與日期。 | 確認重點後更新 CRM。 |
| 團隊分享 | 統一提示詞、欄位、示例與檢查表。 | 共同維護有效做法與失敗案例。 |

## 可執行示例

```sh
npm run demo
npm test
```

輸入為三個虛構商戶，輸出見 [merchant-priorities-demo.json](../results/merchant-priorities-demo.json)。排序採用可解釋權重，缺失服務範圍的商戶會標記為 `research_required`，不會自動發信。此程式處理結構化資料；它沒有呼叫模型，也不把規則評分冒充 AI 預測。

## 小範圍團隊試用

先選一個商圈、一種商戶類型，記錄人工整理一份簡報的時間與錯誤。以相同規格試用 AI 輔助流程，由同事抽查來源、完整度與可用性。只有在實測有收益時才擴展，將範本、示例和常見錯誤一起交接。

建議衡量：每份簡報的中位完成時間、來源可追溯比例、人工更正次數、完成跟進比例。簽約率需要另設觀察期與對照，不能把整理速度直接當成營收成長。這些是試點設計，尚無真實商戶或團隊提效實測。

G.6 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/business-development_EN.md

# AI-assisted research: a merchant example

[繁體中文](business-development.md) · **English**

## From a request to a reusable workflow

Turn an ambiguous request into a workflow, select tools, retain sources, verify the output, and package the method for teammates. The Bilibili project provides real research, delivery, scheduling, and analytics records. The merchant workflow is an offline demonstration of applying those practices to merchant research.

## Example workflow

| Task | AI contribution | Human decision and output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Market research | Structure public sources, classify business types, flag gaps. | Verify business and service-area facts; produce a one-page brief. |
| Prioritisation | Apply transparent criteria to organise leads. | Adjust priorities to territory strategy and capacity. |
| Conversation preparation | Draft value propositions, discovery questions, and objection responses. | Check claims and merchant context before outreach. |
| Follow-up | Convert notes into needs, commitments, owners, and dates. | Confirm the summary before updating CRM. |
| Team enablement | Standardise prompts, fields, examples, and checks. | Maintain useful practices and lessons together. |

## Runnable example

```sh
npm run demo
npm test
```

The input contains three fictional merchants. See [merchant-priorities-demo.json](../results/merchant-priorities-demo.json) for the output. Transparent weights produce a prioritised list; missing service-area information produces `research_required`, with no automatic messaging. The script processes structured data; it makes no model calls and does not present rule-based scores as AI predictions.

## A small team pilot

Start with one territory and merchant type. Measure the time and errors involved in preparing a brief manually. Trial the AI-assisted workflow using the same requirements, with peer checks of sources, completeness, and usability. Expand only if measured results justify it, and hand over templates, examples, and common failure cases together.

Suggested measures are median brief-preparation time, source traceability, human corrections, and follow-up completion. Signing rates need a separate observation window and comparison; faster preparation is not itself revenue growth. This is a pilot design, with no claimed real-merchant or team-efficiency results yet.

# 寫了哪些程式

**繁體中文** · [English](code-map_EN.md)

目前 CrossCast 的實作位於[獨立倉庫](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast)；以下程式連結保留 0.15.1 歷史快照。新增的首次使用與發布前檢查見[11 月 3 日更新](updates/2026-11-03.md)。

本專案採用人類提出需求、AI 協助編寫、工具驗證與人類審閱的方式。程式能否重跑、失敗時怎麼處理，比單純列出語言或程式碼行數更重要。

## CrossCast 上傳與讀取恢復

- [process_lock.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/process_lock.py)：跨程序互斥與確認程序已退出後的鎖標記回收。
- [browser_session.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/browser_session.py): 透過私有管道復用瀏覽器環境.

- [full_read_browser.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/full_read_browser.py): 官方分頁控制與明確結束標記.

## CrossCast 私人收藏集

- `collections_instagram.py`：官方頁面用戶端的持久更名與成員變更。
- `collections_douyin.py`：創作者合集、封面上傳與精確作品增刪。
- `test_collection_members.py`：完整基線、其他成員保留、去重與回應檢查。
- `skills/publishops-crosscast/`：具名 Codex 技能入口。


- [collections.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/collections.py)：帳號與 ID 綁定、持久請求、禁止重送及獨立讀回。
- [collections_browser.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/collections_browser.py)：官方頁面集合控制項、有界觀察及未支援操作的明確回報。
- [test_collections.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/tests/test_collections.py)：帳號不符、部分清單、回應遺失與重複請求保護。

## CrossCast 的速度與播放列表

- [read_scheduler.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/read_scheduler.py)：有界平台並行、獨立檢查點及逐步進度。
- [playlists.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/playlists.py)：YouTube 列表 CRUD、成員排序、請求去重及讀回。
- [test_operations_012.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/tests/test_operations_012.py)：並行隔離、訊息恢復、連線復用、列表歸屬及不確定寫入測試。

## CrossCast 的作品接管與巡檢

- [work_catalog.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/work_catalog.py)：作品目錄、即時歸屬核驗與接管記錄。
- [work_discovery_browser.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/work_discovery_browser.py)：官方頁面的有界翻頁／捲動與管理權限核驗。
- [operations_runs.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/operations_runs.py)：帳號隔離快取、變更清單、API 分頁檢查點及中斷恢復。
- [test_operations_011.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/tests/test_operations_011.py)：快取過期、帳號切換、回執衝突、斷點、續頁與跨平台故障隔離測試。

## 本倉庫可直接執行

| 程式 | 解決的問題 |
| --- | --- |
| [prioritize-merchants.mjs](../scripts/prioritize-merchants.mjs) | 統一商戶欄位、產生可解釋優先級、提示資料不足。 |
| [summarize-channel.mjs](../scripts/summarize-channel.mjs) | 由實際資料重算人類主導歷史與 AI 系列的描述性統計。 |
| [operations-gate.mjs](../scripts/operations-gate.mjs) | 離線示範唯一執行者、停止條件、到期和去重判斷。 |
| [check-delivery.mjs](../scripts/check-delivery.mjs) | 以串流核對影片大小與 SHA-256，避免下載錯版。 |
| [workflows.test.mjs](../tests/workflows.test.mjs) | 驗證重複執行、錯誤時間、未授權工作、缺失資料等情境。 |

```sh
npm run demo
npm run report
npm test
node scripts/check-delivery.mjs /path/to/downloaded/videos
```

不需 npm install；公開示例使用 Node.js 標準函式庫。

## 原製作工程中的程式

- **PowerShell 資料採集包裝器 `run-read.ps1`**：統一 JSON 回傳、來源日誌、呼叫間隔和停止條件。
- **Python 單次發布器 `publish-once.py`**：檔案與中繼資料雜湊鎖定、限時預檢、排他建立執行紀錄、先落盤成功回執再做後處理。
- **Python 影片檢查工具**：媒體格式、解碼、立體聲及機器轉寫檢查；沒有把 ASR 當成人耳驗收。
- **HTML／JavaScript 場景與時間軸**：以語音實際時長安排場景、字幕、過場和已混音音訊。

上述為已檢視原始碼或交付紀錄的實際工程內容；原專案包含帳號綁定設定與大量素材，未在此聲稱已完整公開。公開腳本是為本次作品集整理的可重跑示例，與原生產程式分開標示。

# What the code does

[繁體中文](code-map.md) · **English**

Current CrossCast development lives in the [standalone repository](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast). The code links below preserve the 0.15.1 snapshot. See the [3 November update](updates/2026-11-03_EN.md) for first-run and publication-check improvements.

The project uses human-defined requirements, AI-assisted implementation, tool-based verification, and human review. Reproducibility and failure handling matter more than listing languages or line counts.

## CrossCast upload and read recovery

- [process_lock.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/process_lock.py): cross-process exclusion and marker recovery only after confirmed process exit.
- [browser_session.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/browser_session.py): Private pipe-based context reuse.
- [upload_resume.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/upload_resume.py): Persisted upload sessions and server-offset recovery.
- [full_read.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/full_read.py): Atomic API page checkpoints and full reply reads.
- [full_read_browser.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/full_read_browser.py): Official pagination and explicit end markers.

## CrossCast private collections

- `collections_instagram.py`: official page client for persistent rename and membership changes.
- `collections_douyin.py`: creator collections, cover upload and exact-work membership controls.
- `test_collection_members.py`: full-baseline checks, preservation, deduplication and response validation.
- `skills/publishops-crosscast/`: named Codex skill entry.


- [collections.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/collections.py): account-bound IDs, durable request intents, no resubmission and readback.
- [collections_browser.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/collections_browser.py): official-page collection controls, bounded observations and explicit unsupported operations.
- [test_collections.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/tests/test_collections.py): wrong-account, partial-page, lost-response and duplicate-request guards.

## CrossCast speed and playlist operations

- [read_scheduler.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/read_scheduler.py): bounded platform concurrency, independent checkpoints and incremental progress.
- [playlists.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/playlists.py): YouTube playlist CRUD, membership/order, request deduplication and readback.
- [test_operations_012.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/tests/test_operations_012.py): concurrency isolation, message recovery, connection reuse, playlist ownership and uncertain writes.

## CrossCast work adoption and collection

- [work_catalog.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/work_catalog.py): catalogues, fresh ownership checks and adoption records.
- [work_discovery_browser.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/work_discovery_browser.py): bounded official-page scrolling/pagination and management checks.
- [operations_runs.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/src/video_publisher/operations_runs.py): account-scoped freshness caches, change lists, API page checkpoints and interruption recovery.
- [test_operations_011.py](../tools/publishops-crosscast/tests/test_operations_011.py): expiry, account switching, receipt conflicts, checkpoints, continuations and platform failure isolation.

## Runnable in this repository

| Code | Problem solved |
| --- | --- |
| [prioritize-merchants.mjs](../scripts/prioritize-merchants.mjs) | Standardise lead fields, explain priorities, and flag missing information. |
| [summarize-channel.mjs](../scripts/summarize-channel.mjs) | Recompute descriptive cohort statistics from the actual dataset. |
| [operations-gate.mjs](../scripts/operations-gate.mjs) | Demonstrate sole-operator, stop, due-time, and duplicate checks offline. |
| [check-delivery.mjs](../scripts/check-delivery.mjs) | Stream-check sizes and SHA-256 to identify wrong or incomplete downloads. |
| [workflows.test.mjs](../tests/workflows.test.mjs) | Test duplicate work, invalid times, unauthorised jobs, and missing data. |

```sh
npm run demo
npm run report
npm test
node scripts/check-delivery.mjs /path/to/downloaded/videos
```

No npm install is required; the public examples use Node.js standard libraries.

## Code in the original production workspace

- **PowerShell collection wrapper `run-read.ps1`:** Standardised JSON capture, provenance logs, call intervals, and stop conditions.
- **Python one-shot publisher `publish-once.py`:** Locked media and metadata hashes, time-bounded preflight, exclusive attempt claims, and durable success receipts before post-processing.
- **Python video checks:** Format, decode, stereo, and transcription checks without equating ASR with human listening.
- **HTML/JavaScript scenes and timeline:** Timed scenes, captions, transitions, and baked audio to actual speech duration.

These items are supported by inspected source code or delivery records. The original project includes account-bound configuration and substantial media, so a complete source release is not claimed here. Public scripts are reproducible examples prepared for this portfolio and are distinguished from the original production code.

# 數據對比與判讀

**繁體中文** · [English](data-comparison_EN.md)

來源：2026-10-28 晚間取得的創作中心快照，詳見 [CSV](../data/creator-video-snapshot.csv) 與 [JSON](../data/creator-video-snapshot.json)。下表可由 `npm run report` 重算；結果見 [channel-summary.json](../results/channel-summary.json)。

| 指標 | 歷史人類主導 | 目前 AI 系列 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 稿件數 | 45 | 10 |
| 已公開 | 45 | 5 |
| 排期待發布 | 0 | 5 |
| 已公開稿件累積播放合計 | 1,839,794 | 666 |
| 已公開稿件播放中位數 | 15,407 | 183 |
| 發布日期範圍 | 2019-10-08 – 2026-10-08 | 2026-10-25 – 2026-10-28 |

這張表描述資料覆蓋與現況，**不是模型效果排行榜**。歷史作品有多年累積、題材不同；新系列只有五部已公開影片。不能由此估算 AI 帶來的成長、簽約提升或人力節省。

目前週資料回傳播放 76,162、前期 21,398，以及粉絲增加 40、減少 29、淨增 11。這是全帳號資料，包含歷史作品；不是 AI 系列的獨立增量。[資料](../data/channel-weekly.json)

## 如何判斷 AI 是否真正提高效率

先明確任務目標與驗收條件，再比較相同任務的完成時間、返工次數和結果可用性。記錄樣本大小、工具版本與人工介入，將草稿數量、完成數量和真正可用的成果分開。產出更多文字不等於節省時間；這些是後續評估方法，並非本專案已量測的提效比例。

下午的 52 筆快照與當時數據已保留，見[歷史快照](../data/snapshots/2026-10-28-afternoon/creator-video-snapshot.json)。

This table describes coverage and the snapshot, **not a model-performance leaderboard**. Historical uploads have years of exposure and different topics; the new series has only five public works. It cannot establish AI-driven growth, signing-rate improvements, or labour savings.

The weekly endpoint reported 76,162 plays versus 21,398 in the previous period, with 40 follows, 29 unfollows, and 11 net new followers. These are channel-wide metrics including historical works, not isolated incremental results of the AI series. [Data](../data/channel-weekly.json)

## How to measure practical AI efficiency

Define the task and acceptance criteria before comparing completion time, rework and usefulness on equivalent tasks. Record sample size, tool versions and human intervention. Distinguish drafts, completed tasks and usable outputs. More generated text does not establish time savings. These are evaluation methods, not measured efficiency gains claimed by this project.

# 可編輯影片交付

**繁體中文** · [English](editable-video-workflow_EN.md)

整理日期：**2026-10-28**

## 工作流程

1. **先鎖定台詞與聲音。** 保存選用的原始聲段，依實際音訊時長安排畫面。
2. **場景、字幕、混音共用時間軸。** 標示全片時間與場景內時間，避免片段重用時錯位。
3. **記錄已烘焙的混音。** 若音訊已包含音量與效果，重開工程時避免再次套用。
4. **固定工具與依賴。** 交付版本使用固定的 HyperFrames 版本與本地依賴；重開時先檢查、再預覽、最後渲染。
5. **以實際輸出檔驗收。** 記錄解碼結果、畫面抽查、聲音檢查、人類審片與 SHA-256。

## 兩個實例

| 項目 | 鯨魚娘 02 | 鯨魚娘 03 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 時長 | 116.7 s | 188.8 s |
| 畫面 | 1920 × 1080, 30 fps | 1920 × 1080, 30 fps |
| 總幀數 | 3,501 | 5,664 |
| 已混音元件 | 38 | 47 |
| 選用原始聲段 | 13 | 28 |

02 的第三版修正了第五場的 AI 聲明紅圈。03 的正式交付檔與人類接受的完整有聲預覽逐位元組一致，複製後以雜湊核對。

03 的完整解碼與指定畫面抽查通過；工具檢查的 lint/runtime/layout 錯誤為零，但仍有提示與資訊。代理未以正常速度連續觀看或親耳聽完整片，因此不把機器檢查等同於人工逐字驗收。

## 可重用的交付資訊

使用[交付清單](../templates/delivery-manifest.json)記錄檔名、雜湊、媒體格式、依賴版本、審片方式、未解決問題與發布狀態。未完成的檢查使用 `null` 或 `not_run`，不預填成功。

G.12 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/editable-video-workflow_EN.md

# Editable video delivery

[繁體中文](editable-video-workflow.md) · **English**

Compiled: **2026-10-28**

## Workflow

1. **Lock narration first.** Keep selected voice takes and time the picture to actual audio durations.
2. **Use one timing reference.** Distinguish global and scene-local time when reusing clips.
3. **Document baked audio.** Avoid applying gain or effects twice when reopening a project.
4. **Pin tools and dependencies.** Check, preview, and render with the documented HyperFrames version and local dependencies.
5. **Review the actual output.** Record decode checks, sampled frames, audio checks, human review, and SHA-256.

## Two delivery examples

| Property | Whale Girl 02 | Whale Girl 03 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Duration | 116.7 s | 188.8 s |
| Picture | 1920 × 1080, 30 fps | 1920 × 1080, 30 fps |
| Frames | 3,501 | 5,664 |
| Baked audio components | 38 | 47 |
| Selected unmixed voice takes | 13 | 28 |

Revision 3 of episode 02 corrected the AI-declaration highlight in scene 5. Episode 03's delivered file is byte-identical to the full sound preview accepted by the human reviewer, confirmed by a hash comparison after copying.

Episode 03 passed full decoding and targeted frame checks. Lint/runtime/layout error counts were zero, while warnings and informational messages remained. The agent did not watch and listen to the entire video at normal speed, so machine checks are not presented as word-by-word human review.

## Reusable delivery information

Use the [delivery manifest](../templates/delivery-manifest.json) to record filenames, hashes, formats, dependency versions, review methods, unresolved issues, and publication status. Use `null` or `not_run` for unfinished checks rather than pre-filling success.

# GPT × DeepSeek：分工與驗證

**繁體中文** · [English](model-workflow_EN.md)

**後續工程協作：** Claude 協助構建與介面，Codex 主導後端複核及最終 GitHub 更新；真實發布計時、已交付與待交付功能見[11 月 3 日記錄](updates/2026-11-03.md)。以下 GPT／DeepSeek 案例仍保留當時的證據範圍。

## 已做過什麼

| 面向 | GPT／Codex 工作流 | DeepSeek 營運工作流 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 任務 | 劇本、研究、程式、影片製作與交付整理。 | 讀取檢查表、到期任務、共享進度並持續營運。 |
| 交付證據 | 已公開影片、未發布成片、時間軸與交付核驗。 | 排程觸發、開始、完成與實際工具行為紀錄。 |
| 品質判準 | 技術檢查、畫面抽查與人類審片分開記錄。 | 不重複執行；沒到期就不寫平台；以日誌確認完成。 |

這是一個跨模型工作流接力與執行一致性案例。**沒有同一批提示詞、固定樣本、盲評和完整成本記錄，因此不能據此宣稱 GPT 或 DeepSeek 的能力、速度或成本勝出。** 此處的工作流名稱不是所有請求底層模型版本的獨立身分認證。

## 真實驗證結果

2026-10-28 的每小時輪次在預定時間後 24.992 秒啟動，31.175 秒後完成；觸發來源確為排程。該輪工作未到期，因此沒有 B站平台操作，也沒有為了測試而重跑。細節見[驗證紀錄](automation-verification.md)與[機器可讀證據](../data/scheduled-run-evidence.json)。

## 下一步：商戶研究同題測試

以相同的公開商戶資料、相同提示詞和相同輸出欄位分別測試兩個模型。每份簡報由不看模型名稱的同事檢查：事實正確、來源可追溯、缺失資料是否誠實標記、價值主張是否貼合、人工修正量。時間與成本從實際請求記錄取得，不能估填。

此同題測試是已整理的評估方案，**尚未執行**。本次新增的商戶排序示例是離線程式演示，不是這項模型測試的結果。

# GPT × DeepSeek: roles and verification

[繁體中文](model-workflow.md) · **English**

**Subsequent engineering collaboration:** Claude supports construction and interfaces; Codex leads backend review and final GitHub updates. See the [3 November record](updates/2026-11-03_EN.md) for real publication timing and shipped versus pending work. The GPT/DeepSeek case below retains its original evidence scope.

## What was actually done

| Area | GPT/Codex workflow | DeepSeek operations workflow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task | Scripts, research, code, video production, and delivery. | Read checklists, due work, and shared progress for ongoing operations. |
| Evidence | Published works, upcoming cuts, timelines, and delivery checks. | Scheduled trigger, start, completion, and tool-activity records. |
| Acceptance | Separate technical checks, sampled frames, and human review. | Avoid duplicates, perform no platform writes when nothing is due, verify completion from logs. |

This is a cross-model workflow handoff and execution-consistency case. **There is no shared prompt set, fixed sample, blind review, or complete cost record, so it cannot establish a winner in capability, speed, or cost.** Workflow names do not independently authenticate the underlying model version of every request.

## Observed verification

The verified hourly run on 2026-10-28 started 24.992 seconds after its scheduled time and completed in 31.175 seconds. The trigger was scheduled. No Bilibili actions were due, and no duplicate manual test was launched. See the [verification record](automation-verification_EN.md) and [machine-readable evidence](../data/scheduled-run-evidence.json).

## Next: an identical-task merchant-research test

Give both models the same public merchant data, prompt, and output schema. A reviewer blinded to model names checks factual accuracy, source traceability, explicit gaps, relevance of the value proposition, and required corrections. Time and cost must come from actual request records rather than estimates.

This identical-task evaluation is a documented plan and **has not been run**. The merchant-prioritisation script added here is an offline demonstration, not its result.

G.15 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/research-method.md

# 選題與資料研究方法

**繁體中文** · [English](research-method_EN.md)

每一個選題依序記錄四件事：**原始主張、可見證據、獨立測試、適用限制**。

## 採樣

記錄網址或 BV、作者、發布時間、採樣時間和當時可見指標。同一數字必須連同口徑保存，例如累積播放、昨日播放或最近一週播放；不能混成同一欄。

## 證據與推論

「進入熱門榜」「留言很多」是觀察。「這種剪輯使平台推薦增加」是因果推論，需要其他證據。本倉庫把對照不足的發現當作選題假設，不當作平台演算法規則。

## 人類營運與 AI 系列

初始研究以四個已核實的 BV 作為 AI 系列樣本；其他歷史稿件分組為人類主導時期。這只是研究分組，並不推定歷史作品完全沒有使用 AI 工具。舊作有更長的累積時間，且題材差異大，應先比較同片齡的資料，再討論製作方式的影響。

## 引用與重現

研究筆記連回原始來源；引用影片時保留作者、BV 和使用區間。未跑的測試寫「未執行」，無法取得的數據留空；重複採樣另存時間點，不覆蓋舊結果來假裝時間序列。

G.16 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/research-method_EN.md

# Topic and data research method

[繁體中文](research-method.md) · **English**

For each topic, record four things: **the original claim, visible evidence, an independent test, and applicable limits**.

## Sampling

Record the URL or BV ID, author, publication time, sampling time, and visible metrics. Keep metric definitions—lifetime views, yesterday's views, or weekly views—rather than merging them into one field.

## Evidence and inference

“Appeared in trending” and “received many comments” are observations. “This editing technique increased recommendations” is a causal inference requiring more evidence. Findings without adequate comparison remain hypotheses, not rules about the platform algorithm.

## Human-led history and the AI series

The initial study used four verified BV IDs for its AI-series cohort. Other historical uploads form a human-led-history cohort; that label does not assert that older works used no AI tools. Older uploads have longer exposure and different topics. Compare matched video ages before discussing production-method effects.

## Attribution and reproduction

Link research notes to primary sources. Record creator, BV, and time range for video quotations. Mark unrun tests explicitly and leave unavailable data empty. Save repeated samples as separate observations rather than presenting an overwritten snapshot as a time series.

# 逐幀修復與驗證

**繁體中文** · [English](temporal-quality_EN.md)

案例：GPT 值班日記 05 · v3-antiflash · 2026-10-28

## 問題與修正

畫面在淡入前突然完整出現、右側內容替換時閃白，以及影片入口殘留前一鏡頭，會讓教學難以跟讀。本次修正隱藏初始狀態、將動畫邊界對齊影格、整體替換右側內容區，並在一處入口保留四幀乾淨畫面。沿用 v2 音訊母帶，讓視覺修復不改動已確認的配音。

| 檢查 | 紀錄結果 |
| --- | --- |
| 成片 | 434.47 s · 1920 × 1080 · 30 fps · H.264/AAC |
| 掃描覆蓋 | 13,034／13,034 幀；以 320 × 180 解析度分析 |
| 已知缺陷 | 複核 11 組修正前後片段，回報已修復 |
| 指定脈衝候選 | 孤立 ABA、提前對比峰值、黑色脈衝及右側白色脈衝均為 0 |
| 影片入口 | 複核 12 處入口，72 個入口影格與來源比對 |
| 音訊 | 沿用 v2 音訊母帶；對齊偏移 0 ms；−15.97 LUFS、−2.21 dBTP |

掃描仍找出一個短暫變化事件，來源比對確認是原頁面正常更新；另有 17 處刻意保留的左側換章空隙。這些分類防止把所有變化都當成錯誤。技術檢查與指定畫面複核通過，不等於人工以正常速度逐字看完、聽完整片，也不是光敏安全認證。

## 可複用的問題修復方法

先把「看起來不對」轉成具體錯誤、時間點與驗收條件；局部修復後保留未改動部分，再用同一套指標比對。資料整理、文件和內容製作也可採用相同習慣：鎖定來源、標出錯誤欄位、檢查修正，並讓同事知道哪些內容尚未核實。

數據來自本地交付與逐幀驗證回執；公開摘要見 [production update](../data/production-update-2026-10-28-evening.json)，成片與雜湊見[影片清單](../media/manifest.json)。

G.18 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/docs/temporal-quality_EN.md

# Frame-level repair and verification

[繁體中文](temporal-quality.md) · **English**

Case: GPT Duty Log 05 · v3-antiflash · 2026-10-28

## Problem and fix

A full-opacity frame appearing before a fade, white flashes during panel changes, and a preceding shot leaking into an entry made the tutorial harder to follow. The revision sets explicit hidden initial states, aligns animation boundaries to frames, replaces the right-hand panel as a whole, and uses a four-frame clean-entry hold at one cut. The v2 audio master is retained so visual repairs do not change the selected voice track.

| Check | Recorded result |
| --- | --- |
| Delivery | 434.47 s · 1920 × 1080 · 30 fps · H.264/AAC |
| Scan coverage | 13,034 / 13,034 frames; analysis at 320 × 180 |
| Known defects | 11 before/after sequences reviewed and reported fixed |
| Targeted pulse candidates | 0 isolated ABA; 0 premature contrast peaks; 0 black pulses; 0 right-panel white pulses |
| Video entries | 12 entries reviewed; 72 entry frames compared with sources |
| Audio | Unchanged v2 master; 0 ms alignment offset; −15.97 LUFS, −2.21 dBTP |

One short excursion remained and matched a normal update in the source page. Seventeen intentional gaps during left-panel changes were retained. Classifying such events avoids treating all visual changes as defects. Technical checks and targeted review passed; this is not a claim of continuous human viewing/listening or a photosensitivity safety certification.

## A reusable repair method

Translate vague dissatisfaction into specific defects, locations, and acceptance criteria. Repair the affected part, preserve the rest, and compare with the same measures. The same discipline applies to research, documents and content production: retain sources, identify incorrect fields, verify corrections, and make unresolved claims visible to teammates.

Figures come from local delivery and temporal-QA receipts. See the public [production summary](../data/production-update-2026-10-28-evening.json) and [video manifest](../media/manifest.json).

| FFmpeg／ffprobe | 媒體格式、解碼、混音與編碼檢查。 | 製作交付中的技術檢查紀錄。 |
| Node.js／JavaScript | 資料整理、示例流程、雜湊核對、測試。 | 此次環境 **Node.js 26.11.1**；公開腳本只用標準函式庫。 |
| Python／PowerShell | 原專案發布控制、資料採集與驗證腳本。 | [程式導覽](code-map.md)。 |
| Git | 本地與遠端版本管理。 | 此次環境 **2.53.0.windows.3**。 |

Computer Use 用於原生接口未涵蓋的網頁操作；先使用連接器或 CLI，再以瀏覽器補足。插件和 skill 是工作流入口，並不等於自行訓練了模型。

目前沒有 GitHub Copilot 或 Microsoft Copilot 的實作證據，因此不將它們列為已完成案例。

# 2026-10-29: Episode-six films, day-one data and delivery improvements

[繁體中文](2026-10-29-evening.md) · **English**

This update adds two complete video versions, bringing the public catalogue to 21 versions. The already published CrossCast 0.3.0 code and its 86-test record remain unchanged. This run updates the media archive, data and production notes.

## Complete exports and schedules

| Work | Version and duration | Bilibili schedule (UTC+8) |
|---|---|---|
| GPT Duty Log 06: Step by step, getting DeepSeek to help with my work | v2, 591.47 seconds | 2026-10-31 12:00 |
| Whale Girl Shift Log 06: AI does the automation; I pretend to be human | v2, 184.20 seconds | 2026-11-02 12:00 |

Both operations receipts record platform review approval with publication pending. Earlier production receipts retain their awaiting-user-review status as history; platform approval does not establish full user acceptance. Publishing the archive on GitHub does not change the Bilibili schedules. [Downloads and hashes](../../media/README_EN.md) · [This release](https://github.com/whitecarp/agentic-work-lab/releases/tag/update-2026-10-29-evening)

Whale Girl Shift Log 03 became public on Bilibili at 19:30 on 29 October, with operations readback at 19:30:36 confirming public access. Its existing download file is unchanged and was not uploaded again. [State data](../../data/production-update-2026-10-29-evening.json)

## Reusable practices from revision work

- **Keep tutorial dialogue complete.** GPT06 v2 places 18 tutorial messages on a continuous chat page. Older messages scroll before new ones arrive, preserving the current bubble and reducing split terms and isolated trailing characters.
- **Attach callouts to stable footage.** Boxes and arrows for input fields, API settings and instance controls were repositioned; fixed callouts are removed during short moving transitions. Footage comes from sanitized source media; raw recordings are excluded from public delivery.
- **Preserve approved voice and wording.** Only three GPT06 narration clips were regenerated in this revision; 46 source WAVs were retained. Whale Girl 06 v2 reused existing voices, adjusted relative role levels and three caption timings, and round-tripped all 44 lines with punctuation intact.
- **State the verification boundary.** GPT06 contains 17,744 encoded frames and Whale Girl 06 contains 5,526. Delivery records include full decoding, audio comparisons and sampled-frame checks, without claiming continuous human viewing or listening. For the latter, explicit user acceptance is recorded only for a 47-second preview.

These methods can be reused in other tutorials and team handoffs. No controlled experiment quantifies time saved. [Delivery workflow](../editable-video-workflow_EN.md)

## Whale Girl 02 day-one observation

Sampled at 19:33 on 2026-10-29, 24 hours and three minutes after publication: 308 views, 24 likes, five favourites, 51 replies, 36.63% completion and 42 seconds of average watch time on a 117-second film.

Replies are not unique viewers. Different duration, topics and publication times mean a direct comparison with GPT03's day-one metrics cannot establish differences in model ability or operating efficiency. [Recorded metrics](../../data/whale-log02-24h-2026-10-29.json) · [Comparison and limits](../data-comparison_EN.md)

## Current CrossCast evidence

The 0.3.0 record published earlier today includes episode-two submission and readback on YouTube, Instagram and X. Douyin was submitted and a review card observed, but login expired after restart and final readback remains pending; this run did not reupload it. The 86 passing offline tests belong to that code update and were not rerun for this documentation change. [Full validation record](../../tools/publishops-crosscast/docs/VALIDATION_EN.md)

This run did not retrieve a new full-channel dataset. The 55-record snapshot and human-led/AI-series comparison retain their 28 October sampling date; partial new receipts are not merged into the old totals.

# 2026-10-30：變身實驗精修與發布狀態

**繁體中文** · [English](2026-10-30-evening_EN.md)

本次整理兩份完整實驗交付：v3 為 67 秒，v4 為 75.23 秒。原先待上傳的檔案已於 2026-11-01 補上 Release，大小與 SHA-256 均已讀回核對；本頁的製作與 B站觀察仍保留原採樣日期。[媒體目錄](../../media/README.md) · [結構化記錄](../../data/production-update-2026-10-30-evening.json)

## 從具體問題到可驗證修正

v4 保留原素材與較早的 v3，針對回報的時間點修改。主要做法包括：用源片中較早的推臉段避開尾部與肢體收束問題；在兩段交接處匹配亮度；針對瞳孔突跳，以真實前後眼區做局部光流插值；截去回擺姿態，改用尾部近景完成銜接。

聲音與畫面分開驗證：笑臉停留時音樂繼續，被拖走的段落、漸黑與黑場靜音；合照後音樂恢復，結尾喊聲下方將音樂壓低 12 dB。v4 的局部保護範圍也修正了 v3 尾鰭進入頭髮處理區的問題，未把固定遮罩當成完整物體辨識。

這些是可重用的製作與驗收方法，沒有量測節省工時，也不代表所有畫風與動作差異均已消除。

## 技術證據與驗收邊界

| 項目 | v4 交付記錄 |
|---|---|
| 編碼 | 1080×1920、30 fps、2,257 幀、H.264／AAC |
| 完整解碼 | 通過 |
| 音訊 | 0 削波樣本；取樣峰值約 −1.636 dBFS |
| 靜音驗證窗 | 50.763–62.503 秒，解碼樣本全零 |
| 全黑 | 首個全黑幀為第 1,845 幀，即 61.500 秒 |
| 原片保留 | v3 雜湊保持；音訊混合未重編碼 v4 畫面流 |

交付包含逐幀與訊號檢查，局部對照圖的視覺檢查不等於全片連續觀看或主觀耳聽。兩版均作實驗交付展示，不標記為使用者全片驗收通過。原始錄屏、第三方參考原片、私人對話及未完成中間檔不納入此次公開更新。

# 2026-10-30: Transformation-study repairs and publication state

[繁體中文](2026-10-30-evening.md) · **English**

Two complete experimental deliveries are documented: v3 (67 seconds) and v4 (75.23 seconds). Their pending Release uploads were completed on 1 November 2026, with sizes and SHA-256 digests read back and matched. Production and Bilibili observations retain their original sampling dates. [Media catalogue](../../media/README_EN.md) · [Structured record](../../data/production-update-2026-10-30-evening.json)

## Turning specific defects into verifiable repairs

Version 4 preserves original assets and the earlier v3 while addressing reported timestamps. It uses an earlier face push to avoid problematic tail/body motion, matches brightness across a cut, interpolates only the eye regions between real source endpoints to repair abrupt gaze jumps, and replaces a returning pose with a tail close-up.

Audio and picture are checked separately: music continues during the smile hold; the drag-away scene, fade and black interval are silent. Music returns over the group portrait and ducks by 12 dB under the final shout. The v4 protection region also corrects the v3 case where a moving tail fin entered the hair mask; a fixed mask was not treated as full object recognition.

These are reusable production and validation practices. No time-saving percentage was measured, and residual style/motion differences are not claimed to be eliminated.

## Technical evidence and acceptance limits

| Check | Recorded v4 result |
|---|---|
| Encoding | 1080×1920, 30 fps, 2,257 frames, H.264/AAC |
| Full decode | Passed |
| Audio | Zero clipped samples; sample peak approximately −1.636 dBFS |
| Silence window | Decoded samples all zero from 50.763 to 62.503 seconds |
| Full black | First full-black frame: 1,845, at 61.500 seconds |
| Preservation | v3 hash unchanged; v4 picture stream was copied during audio mixing |

Delivery includes frame and signal checks. Inspection of local comparison images does not establish continuous full-film viewing or subjective listening. Both versions are experimental deliveries, not labelled as full user acceptance. Raw recordings, standalone third-party reference clips, private conversations and unfinished intermediate files are excluded.

## GPT episode four is public

The operations receipt records [GPT Duty Log 04](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xFx764EjN) becoming public at 12:00 on 30 October 2026 (UTC+8), with public access checked at 13:00. Eight chapters were saved and read back, but chapter review remains pending in that receipt; collection listing was also delayed. Neither is presented as fully complete. The video hash is unchanged; no duplicate upload or schedule edit was performed.

No newer full-channel or day-one dataset was collected in this run. The [data comparison](../data-comparison_EN.md) retains its original sampling dates and populations; schedules and pending samples are not converted into view estimates.

## Tool version

The published CrossCast **0.15.1** and its 417-test record are preserved. This update changes research notes, the media catalogue and state only; it adds no CLI features and does not rerun that version's tests. [Validation record](../../tools/publishops-crosscast/docs/VALIDATION_EN.md)

| 變身實驗 v3／v4 | 保留較早版本，記錄眼區插值、亮度銜接及音畫分開檢查。 | 67 秒／75.23 秒；補完成先前待上傳的附件。原有採樣與驗收限制見[10月30日記錄](2026-10-30-evening.md)。 |
| 局部調色與腳步聲修訂5 | 對衣料、膚色及背景分區處理，保護藍色尾巴；保留六段既有腳步／拖動聲及其時間位置。 | 66.87 秒、2006 幀、1080×1920、30 fps；交付回執記錄完整解碼及局部邊界檢查。來源混音分離可能有殘留；沿用全軌解碼浮點峰值約 +1.11 dBFS，未作全局重混。 |
| 動作節奏修訂7 | 用來源真實幀重新安排襪子與比心段，避免交替步長造成頓挫；新段不加光流中間幀。 | 65.37 秒、1961 幀、1080×1920、30 fps；回執記錄完整解碼、接點與重複幀檢查。畫面放大及動作觀感仍待完整主觀驗收。 |

兩份新修訂來自不同製作分支，不能當成同一條線性版本比較。它們是完整實驗交付，**不是全片使用者驗收或平台活動審核通過的聲明**；本輪沒有刷新 B站發布狀態。原始錄屏、獨立第三方參考片、局部渲染與仍在製作的第七期資產未上傳。

## 開發與驗證分工

CrossCast 的獨立倉庫仍在處理既有功能驗收。[PR #3](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/3) 在本輪核對時保持開啟，分支頭為 `80e166b`；本機另有 `988bee2` 候選包，不能把本機候選寫成公開正式版本。本實驗室保留 `0.15.1` 歷史程式快照，本輪未匯入候選程式碼，也未合併 PR。

- `eaa1aab` 的 [GitHub CI](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/actions/runs/41301333026) 已核實在 Python 3.10／3.11／3.12 通過離線測試、wheel 建置及 CLI 安裝檢查；結果僅對應該提交。
- `80e166b` 有143項本機針對性測試通過；X 書籤夾移除、獨立空清單讀回及清理完成。較早「找不到控制項」的重繪解釋仍是推論。
- `988bee2` 的13項針對性測試通過，但獨立反例仍發現置頂評論識別不夠精確，因此沒有繼續真實置頂測試。抖音已有草稿的防護只驗證至3秒觀察窗。
- YouTube 播放列表選取已通過該次測試，後續排期讀回失敗；抖音排期卡片的時間及私密標記可見，但 CLI 讀回逾時。兩者的臨時項目均已清理，不把原始失敗回執改成成功。

可重用的做法是：交付包綁定版本與雜湊；離線測試、反例、真實操作及清理各自留證；失敗後先核對已有結果，避免重複提交。這些是工程方法，沒有量測團隊節省工時或模型能力排名。

## 資料口徑

全帳號資料與人類主導／AI 系列比較仍保留原採樣日；沒有新增可比的流量樣本，不從排期日期推算已發布或成效。第七期美術仍屬製作中資產，待完整交付後再處理。[資料說明](../../data/README.md)

[返回實驗室](../../README.md)

# 2026-11-01: Completed deliveries, version preservation and independent validation

[繁體中文](2026-11-01.md) · **English**

This update completes two previously pending study uploads and adds two complete deliveries, bringing the archive to **25 downloadable versions**. All four additions were matched against remote sizes and SHA-256 digests; earlier public versions remain available. [Video catalogue](../../media/README_EN.md) · [Update data](../../data/production-update-2026-11-01.json)

## Turning feedback into checkable repairs

| Delivery | Method | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|---|
| Transformation studies v3/v4 | Preserve the earlier cut and document local eye interpolation, brightness matching and separate audio/picture checks. | 67 / 75.23 seconds; completes the pending attachments. Original observations and acceptance limits remain in the [30 October record](2026-10-30-evening_EN.md). |
| Local colour and heel-sound revision 5 | Treat clothing, skin and background separately while protecting the blue tail; preserve six existing heel/drag events and their timing. | 66.87 seconds, 2006 frames, 1080×1920, 30 fps. The delivery records full decode and local boundary checks. Source-mix separation may retain residual sound; the inherited decoded floating-point track peak is about +1.11 dBFS, with no global remaster. |
| Motion-timing revision 7 | Reorder real source frames for the sock and heart gestures, avoiding uneven alternating steps; no optical-flow frames in the new segments. | 65.37 seconds, 1961 frames, 1080×1920, 30 fps. The receipt records full decode, join and duplicate-frame checks. Upscaling and motion appearance still need complete subjective review. |

The two new revisions come from different production branches, not one linear comparison. They are complete experimental deliveries, **not claims of full user acceptance or platform-event approval**. Bilibili publication state was not refreshed. Raw screen recordings, standalone third-party references, segment renders and episode-seven assets still in production were excluded.

## Separating development from validation

The standalone CrossCast repository is still closing existing acceptance items. [PR #3](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/3) was open at this check, with branch head `80e166b`. A separate local `988bee2` candidate must not be described as a public release. This lab retains its historical `0.15.1` code snapshot; no candidate code was imported and no PR was merged in this update.

- [GitHub CI for eaa1aab](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/actions/runs/41301333026) was independently verified: Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 passed offline tests, wheel build and CLI installation checks. That result applies to that commit.
- `80e166b` passed 143 targeted local tests. X folder removal, a separate complete empty read and cleanup passed. A redraw as the cause of the older missing-control error remains a hypothesis.
- `988bee2` passed 13 targeted tests, but independent counterexamples still found imprecise pinned-comment identification, so further live pin actions remained held. Douyin's kept-draft guard was validated only within its 3-second observation window.
- YouTube playlist selection passed the scoped trial, followed by a schedule read-back failure. A Douyin scheduled card showed the requested time and private marker, but CLI read-back timed out. Temporary items were cleaned up; original failure receipts were not relabelled as successful.

Reusable practices include immutable versioned packages, separate evidence for tests/counterexamples/live actions/cleanup, and checking existing results before repeating a submission. These are engineering practices, not measured team-efficiency gains or model rankings.

## Data scope

Full-channel statistics and human-led/AI-series comparisons retain their original sample dates. No new comparable traffic sample was added, and elapsed schedule times do not establish publication or performance. Episode-seven artwork remains in production and will be considered after complete delivery. [Data notes](../../data/README_EN.md)

# 2026-11-02：第七期交付、直式重構與跨平台驗證

**繁體中文** · [English](2026-11-02_EN.md)

新增第七期橫式成片及三條直式切片，共 **4 個完整影片檔案**，媒體庫累計 **29 個版本**。每個檔案都比對製作回執的 SHA-256、檢查格式並完整解碼；遠端附件另核對大小與 SHA-256。[下載與索引](../../media/README.md) · [本輪資料](../../data/production-update-2026-11-02.json)

## 從同一份素材做出不同畫面的交付

第七期以自製《大肥魚值班模擬器》的三種玩法組織劇情：全部接受、全部拒絕與全部敷衍。遊戲工單及人物是虛構內容，並非真實客戶或商戶資料。發牌順序經過挑選，影片中的第4、5、6張工單失敗屬於刻意選出的案例，不能當作遊戲平均表現或模型能力比較。

| 版本 | 格式與時長 | 驗收範圍 |
|---|---|---|
| 橫式 v3 | 1920×1080，30 fps，5393 幀，179.77 秒 | 製作紀錄記載使用者對全片的整體回饋為無明顯問題；不是每項配音、節奏與聲畫同步的逐項驗收。 |
| 直式 A：斷糧代班人 | 1080×1920，843 幀，28.10 秒 | 完整輸出；待正常速度觀看、聆聽與真機覆蓋區檢查。 |
| 直式 B：差評製造機 | 1080×1920，897 幀，29.90 秒 | 同上；剪去部分工單，計數如實跳過。 |
| 直式 C：幻覺藝術家 | 1080×1920，899 幀，29.97 秒 | 同上；長圖重現該班真實遊戲輸出，屬於重製畫面。 |

直式版重新安排工單與角色面板，並非直接裁切橫片。製作檢查以360像素寬預覽字幕、數字和章的位置；字幕56 px、數字106 px，重要內容放在168–1330 px區域。這是本次構圖的經驗範圍，並非平台官方安全區，也不代表已在所有手機驗證。

製作紀錄量到直式三片響度為 −17.5／−16.6／−17.5 LUFS、峰值約 −1.5 dBFS，沒有削波樣本。橫片舊紀錄曾寫大部分蓋章對齊在6毫秒內，後續逐幀檢查卻發現第一張工單印章約早於聲音130毫秒；其他工單與稱號章仍含按相同時序推算的部分。此處保留這個量測分歧，不把舊數字當成已通過的精度證明。直式11次工單蓋章的製作檢查記錄在一幀內，仍不取代完整聆聽。

## GitHub 存檔與 B站排期分開記錄

本輪只讀取既有上傳回執：橫片記錄排在 **2026-11-03 12:00（UTC+8）**，三條直式影片另合成多P稿件，記錄排在 **同日19:30**。多P順序是 B、C、A；檔案內容相同，因此 GitHub 每條只存一次。較早B單條的上傳回執保留為歷史證據，其當前狀態未刷新。本輪沒有查詢或改動平台排期，也不將提交成功寫成已公開。

## CrossCast：把成功的範圍說清楚

[PR #3](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/3) 在本輪檢查時尚未合併。以下實測限於候選提交 `2d54c8f`；本實驗室繼續保留 `0.15.1` 歷史程式快照，沒有匯入候選程式碼。

- 該提交的 [GitHub CI](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/actions/runs/41380631557) 在 Python 3.10、3.11、3.12 通過離線測試、wheel 建置和安裝後 CLI 檢查；本機另通過16項針對性檢查。兩者不是全平台功能驗收的替代。
- X 新上傳可進入正確素材的發布預覽，原始媒體容器與編輯器內的影片來源一致；沒有按下公開發布。測試素材已刪除並重新載入確認不存在。
- 一次遠期 X 排期按下最終 Done 後，獨立檢查找到文字、日期及時間一致的唯一列；排期及素材隨後刪除並讀回確認。CLI 原回執仍是 `SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED`：該列沒有可持久化的作品／媒體ID配對，不能因看到相同文字便改報完整核驗成功，也沒有驗證未來時間到達後的發布。
- 抖音私密測試片的卡片與編輯頁均讀到完整文字及零個多餘星號；但平台顯示修改審核中。這份快照中尚未執行編輯，測試仍待審核與清理，不能寫成編輯功能已通過。

這些紀錄展示如何把 AI 協助開發的流程做成可交接的工作：版本綁定、針對性反例、一次提交、獨立讀回、清理與待辦分開保存。沒有以測試數量推論商戶成長或團隊節省工時。

## 素材與限制

遊戲畫面來自自製遊戲；角色圖由 AI 協助製作，GPT擬人角色設計參考 ZipZipPipe《AI娘化》，並非 OpenAI 官方角色。配音使用 Breeze 與 Microsoft Edge TTS。背景音樂為 Kevin MacLeod（[incompetech.com](https://incompetech.com/)）的 Easy Lemon、Investigations、Night on the Docks、Sneaky Snitch、Two Together，採 [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)；音樂經節選、淡入淡出、音量調整及對白下壓。不同切片使用其中不同曲目。

原始錄屏、帳號資料與製作中的資產未隨附件公開。沒有新增流量樣本；人類主導／AI系列比較繼續使用原採樣日期。[資料口徑](../../data/README.md) · [前次更新](2026-11-01.md) · [返回實驗室](../../README.md)

# 2026-11-02: episode 07 deliveries, portrait layouts and platform validation

[繁體中文](2026-11-02.md) · **English**

This update adds the landscape episode 07 and three portrait cuts: **four complete video files**, bringing the archive to **29 versions**. Each file matches its production receipt's SHA-256, has its format checked and decodes completely; remote assets are separately checked for size and SHA-256. [Downloads and index](../../media/README_EN.md) · [Update data](../../data/production-update-2026-11-02.json)

## Different layouts from the same production materials

Episode 07 uses three strategies in the original Duty Simulator game: accept everything, reject everything and bluff through every task. Its tickets and characters are fictional, not customer or merchant records. The ticket order was selected deliberately. Failing at tickets four, five and six represents chosen cases, not average gameplay or a comparison of model capabilities.

| Version | Format and duration | Acceptance scope |
|---|---|---|
| Landscape v3 | 1920×1080, 30 fps, 5,393 frames, 179.77 s | The production record reports the user's overall impression as having no obvious issues; this is not separate acceptance of every voice, pacing and synchronisation detail. |
| Portrait A: running out of resources | 1080×1920, 843 frames, 28.10 s | Complete export; continuous playback, listening and phone-overlay checks remain outstanding. |
| Portrait B: refusing every request | 1080×1920, 897 frames, 29.90 s | Same limits; some tickets are omitted and the counters visibly skip them. |
| Portrait C: bluffing through the shift | 1080×1920, 899 frames, 29.97 s | Same limits; the scrolling graphic recreates the actual game output from that shift. |

The portrait cuts rearrange the ticket and character panels instead of cropping the landscape film. Production checks inspected subtitles, numbers and stamps at a 360-pixel preview width. Subtitles use 56 px, numbers 106 px, and important content sits between y=168 and y=1330. This is a layout choice for these videos, not an official platform safe area or proof of compatibility with every phone.

Production measurements recorded −17.5/−16.6/−17.5 LUFS for the portrait cuts, peaks around −1.5 dBFS and no clipped samples. The older landscape notes claimed most stamp cues aligned within 6 ms; a later frame check found the first ticket's stamp appearing about 130 ms before its sound. Some remaining ticket and title-stamp estimates were inferred from the same timing. This discrepancy is retained rather than presenting the earlier number as a verified accuracy result. The portrait production checks placed the 11 ticket-stamp cues within one frame, which still does not replace continuous listening.

## GitHub archiving and Bilibili schedules are different states

This run only read existing submission receipts. The landscape film was recorded for **2026-11-03 12:00 (UTC+8)**; the portrait files were also submitted as a multi-part work for **19:30 that day**, in B, C, A order. Identical files are archived only once on GitHub. An earlier standalone B submission remains historical evidence; its current state was not refreshed. No platform schedule was queried or changed, and successful submission is not reported as public availability.

## CrossCast: report exactly what passed

[PR #3](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/3) was unmerged when checked. The field results below apply to candidate commit `2d54c8f`. This lab retains its historical `0.15.1` code snapshot and has not imported candidate code.

- That commit's [GitHub CI](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/actions/runs/41380631557) passed offline tests, wheel builds and installed-CLI checks on Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12. Another 16 targeted local checks passed. Neither result replaces full platform acceptance.
- A fresh X upload reached the correct media's publishing preview, with the same video source in the retained media container and composer. Public Post was not pressed. The temporary media was deleted and independently confirmed absent after reloading.
- A future X schedule was submitted with one final Done press. An independent read found a unique row with the expected text, date and time; the schedule and media were then deleted and confirmed absent. The original CLI receipt remains `SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED`: the row lacked a durable post/media ID pairing. Matching words alone do not justify upgrading the receipt, and publication when the scheduled time arrives was not tested.
- The Douyin private test's card and edit page contained the exact caption and no stray stars, but the platform held modification for review. At this snapshot, no edit had been attempted and review/cleanup were pending. This is not a passed caption-edit test.

These records demonstrate a reusable approach to AI-assisted engineering: bind evidence to versions, test counterexamples, submit once, read back independently, and track cleanup and pending work separately. Test counts do not establish merchant growth or team time savings.

## Materials and limits

Game footage comes from the original game. Character art is AI-assisted; the GPT character design references ZipZipPipe's AI-personification work and is not an official OpenAI character. Voices use Breeze and Microsoft Edge TTS. Music by Kevin MacLeod ([incompetech.com](https://incompetech.com/)): Easy Lemon, Investigations, Night on the Docks, Sneaky Snitch and Two Together, under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were excerpted, faded, level-adjusted and ducked beneath dialogue; individual cuts use different subsets.

Raw recordings, account data and unfinished assets are excluded. No new traffic sample was collected; human-led/AI-series comparisons keep their original sampling dates. [Data scope](../../data/README_EN.md) · [Previous update](2026-11-01_EN.md) · [Back to the lab](../../README_EN.md)

# 成片發布與一次真實上傳計時

**繁體中文** · [English](2026-11-03_EN.md)

資料截點：2026-11-03 04:16 UTC。本次新增《我替你看過了》v3 成片，影片存檔累計 **30 個版本**；同時整理 CrossCast 已發布版本與一次 Instagram 真實發布的計時。歷史人工營運及 AI 系列的播放、完播率等數據未重新採樣。

## 《我替你看過了》

一部以虛構故事表現 AI 代看、成本與人的選擇的短片。人類提出方向、片名並回饋；製作流程以程式組織畫面、文字、配樂與音效。故事不代表真實觀眾留言或商戶成果。

- 本輪讀取原檔與存檔副本各一次，SHA-256 相符，並核對 GitHub 附件的大小與雜湊。先前曾觀察到間歇性的本機讀取差異，原因尚未確定；本輪校驗通過不代表根因已修復。

## 平台結果各自記錄

|---|---|

遠端封面像素及各站全片播放沒有全面複驗。表中的平台結果來自各次發布與使用者確認，並非本次自動更新重新操作帳號所得。

## 先量等待，再決定優化位置

Instagram 的發布命令用了 **412.217 秒（約 6 分 52 秒）**，其中點擊 Share 後到平台確認的等待為 **380.551 秒，約 92%**。這段同時包含傳輸、處理與確認，現有計時無法拆開；不能直接歸因於網路，也不能當作平台平均速度。

| 階段 | 秒 |
|---|---:|
| 原檔與計畫校驗（發布命令外） | 0.438 |
| 本機發布預演（發布命令外） | 0.444 |
| 登入預檢及關閉（發布命令外） | 10.137 |
| 發布命令：開啟瀏覽器至檔案入口 | 11.058 |
| 發布命令：提交後等待 | 380.551 |
| 發布命令：獨立讀回 | 5.224 |

這是單次觀察，表格列出主要階段，並非相加後就等於整個命令。此次沒有重試或第二次 Share。後續優化應讓等待階段清楚可見，並驗證不同平台並行時是否真能縮短總耗時；目前沒有真實並行發布的加速數字。

## 軟體交付狀態

- [CrossCast v0.16.0](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/releases/tag/v0.16.0) 已公開，安裝包對應 `a46bd19`；本實驗室內的程式仍保留 **0.15.1 歷史快照**。
- 後續已合併的 [PR 8](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/8) 縮短預設能力清單，完整內容仍可用 `--full`；[PR 9](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/9) 改善首次使用說明與發布前檢查。截點時主分支為 `69aa590`，這些更新未重打包進既有 v0.16.0 附件。
- [PR 10](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/10) 的 `prepare`／`go` 兩指令流程仍待合併；有界並行發布仍在審查。這些是待交付工作，不能當作已發布功能或已證實的速度提升。
- 實際協作分工是：人類決定需求與驗收，Claude 協助構建及介面，Codex 主導後端檢查、優化與 GitHub 最終更新。這是工作流程紀錄，不是模型能力排名。

# Film publication and one real upload timing

[繁體中文](2026-11-03.md) · **English**

Snapshot: 2026-11-03 04:16 UTC. This update archives v3 of *I Watched It For You*, bringing the catalogue to **30 video versions**, and records CrossCast release status and one real Instagram publication. Historical human-led and AI-series views, completion rates and other channel metrics were not resampled.

## I Watched It For You

A fictional short about an AI watching on someone's behalf, costs and human choices. A person supplied direction, the title and feedback; the production workflow organised images, text, music and effects in code. The story does not represent real viewer comments or merchant outcomes.

- [Download the film](https://github.com/whitecarp/agentic-work-lab/releases/download/update-2026-11-03-film/i-watched-it-for-you-v3-20261102.mp4): 176.4 seconds, 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264/AAC, 285,855,005 bytes.
- Production notes record an error-free full decode and 37 sampled frames. Those checks do not establish full subjective audio acceptance or mobile subtitle readability. Small English subtitles remain a documented limitation.
- This update read the source and archive copy once each and matched their SHA-256 values, then checked the GitHub asset's size and digest. An earlier intermittent local read discrepancy remains unexplained; a matching check does not prove its root cause was repaired.

## Platform results retain their individual evidence

| Platform | Work and evidence carried into this update |
|---|---|
| Bilibili | [Watch](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV15B4F6hEYr): the production session recorded public availability on 2 November at 21:00 Beijing time; Bilibili was not queried again here. |
| YouTube | [Watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AzW6vr8nvDM): publication continued from the original draft; the native receipt, full copy and public visibility passed read-back. |
| X | [Watch](https://x.com/White_Carp2000/status/2117261340633161838): publication reused the original media; receipt and 176.4-second duration verified, stored resolution not independently established. |
| Douyin | The user's phone screenshot confirms the work and production cover are visible. Programmatic read-back timed out, so the native receipt remains UNKNOWN; it was neither relabelled successful nor republished. |
| Instagram | [Watch](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfQ9iCiCWYN/): one upload and one Share on 3 November; native receipt and full Chinese/English caption read-back passed. Original aspect ratio, AI label on, sharing to other apps off; the user confirmed replacing the cover on mobile. |

Remote cover pixels and full playback were not comprehensively checked across all platforms. These results come from their respective publication runs and user confirmations, not fresh account operations by this daily update.

## Measure the wait before choosing an optimisation

The Instagram publication command took **412.217 seconds (about 6 minutes 52 seconds)**. The wait from Share to platform confirmation was **380.551 seconds, about 92%**. That period includes transfer, processing and confirmation; the measurements cannot separate them, identify a network cause or establish average platform speed.

| Phase | Seconds |
|---|---:|
| Source and plan checks, outside publication command | 0.438 |
| Local rehearsal, outside publication command | 0.444 |
| Sign-in preflight and close, outside publication command | 10.137 |
| Publication command: browser start to file entry | 11.058 |
| Publication command: wait after submission | 380.551 |
| Publication command: independent read-back | 5.224 |

This is one observation. The table selects major phases rather than an exhaustive additive breakdown. There was no retry or second Share. Follow-up work should make the waiting phase understandable and measure whether publishing to different platforms concurrently actually reduces total time. No live concurrent-publication speedup has been measured yet.

## Software delivery status

- [CrossCast v0.16.0](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/releases/tag/v0.16.0) is public; its installable assets correspond to `a46bd19`. The code inside this lab remains a **historical 0.15.1 snapshot**.
- Merged [PR 8](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/8) shortens the default capability list and keeps the full output behind `--full`; [PR 9](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/9) improves first-run guidance and publication checks. Main was `69aa590` at the snapshot. These changes have not been repackaged into the existing v0.16.0 assets.
- [PR 10](https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast/pull/10), the two-command `prepare`/`go` flow, still awaits merge. Bounded concurrent publication remains under review. Neither is presented here as a shipped feature or a demonstrated speed improvement.
- In this collaboration, the person sets requirements and acceptance; Claude helps with construction and interface work, while Codex leads backend review, optimisation and final GitHub updates. This documents a workflow, not a ranking of model ability.

G.40 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/scripts/check-delivery.mjs

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';

const directory=process.argv[2];
if(!directory){console.error('Usage: node scripts/check-delivery.mjs <download-directory>');process.exitCode=2;}
else {
  const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('media/manifest.json','utf8'));
  const results=[];
  for(const item of manifest.items){
    if(path.basename(item.file)!==item.file)throw Error('Unsafe manifest filename');
    const target=path.join(directory,item.file);
    if(!fs.existsSync(target)){results.push({file:item.file,status:'missing'});continue;}
    const hash=crypto.createHash('sha256');
    for await (const chunk of fs.createReadStream(target)) hash.update(chunk);
    const digest=hash.digest('hex');
    results.push({file:item.file,status:digest===item.sha256&&fs.statSync(target).size===item.bytes?'verified':'mismatch'});
  }
  console.log(JSON.stringify({results},null,2));
  if(results.some(r=>r.status!=='verified'))process.exitCode=1;
}

G.41 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/scripts/operations-gate.mjs

// Pure offline decision function: no scheduling, network access, or account actions.
export function planRun({executor, owner, stop = false, running = false, now, jobs = []}) {
  const current = Date.parse(now);
  if (!Number.isFinite(current)) throw new Error('Invalid current time');
  if (!executor || executor !== owner) return {decision:'skip',reason:'not_owner',due:[]};
  if (stop) return {decision:'skip',reason:'stop_flag',due:[]};
  if (running) return {decision:'skip',reason:'already_running',due:[]};
  const ids = new Set();
  const due = [];
  for (const job of jobs) {
    if (!job.id || ids.has(job.id)) throw new Error('Missing or duplicate job id');
    ids.add(job.id);
    if (job.completed === true || job.authorized !== true) continue;
    const at = Date.parse(job.due_at);
    if (!Number.isFinite(at)) throw new Error('Invalid due time for '+job.id);
    if (at <= current) due.push(job.id);
  }
  return {decision:due.length?'plan_only':'no_work_due',reason:'checked',due};
}

export function verifyScheduledRun(record) {
  const start = Date.parse(record.started_at), end = Date.parse(record.completed_at);
  return record.trigger === 'automation_heartbeat_scheduled' &&
    record.status === 'VERIFIED_AUTOMATIC_RUN_COMPLETED' &&
    record.manual_test_triggered === false &&
    Number.isFinite(start) && Number.isFinite(end) && end >= start &&
    Array.isArray(record.task_errors) && record.task_errors.length === 0;
}

G.42 Technical Protocol & Record: agentic-work-lab/scripts/prioritize-merchants.mjs

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';

// Offline demonstration. Scores are a configurable prioritisation rule, not AI predictions.
export function prioritize(input) {
  if (!Array.isArray(input.merchants)) throw new Error('merchants must be an array');
  const seen = new Set();
  const weights = {category_fit: 40, service_area_fit: 30, evidence_quality: 30};
  const merchants = input.merchants.map(m => {
    if (!m.id || seen.has(m.id)) throw new Error('Missing or duplicate merchant id');
    seen.add(m.id);
    const missing = [];
    let score = 0;
    for (const [key, weight] of Object.entries(weights)) {
      if (m[key] == null) { missing.push(key); continue; }
      if (typeof m[key] !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(m[key]) || m[key] < 0 || m[key] > 1) throw new Error('Invalid score: ' + key);
      score += m[key] * weight;
    }
    const hasEvidence = Array.isArray(m.evidence) && m.evidence.some(e => e.reviewed === true && typeof e.source === 'string' && e.source.trim());
    return {
      id: m.id, name_zh_hant: m.name_zh_hant, name_en: m.name_en,
      score: Math.round(score * 100) / 100,
      missing_fields: missing,
      next_step: missing.length || !hasEvidence ? 'research_required' : 'human_review',
      outreach_sent: false,
      evidence: m.evidence ?? [],
      discussion_angle_zh_hant: m.discussion_angle_zh_hant,
      discussion_angle_en: m.discussion_angle_en
    };
  }).sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  return {demo: input.demo === true, method: 'transparent_weighted_rule_not_model_prediction', weights, merchants};
}

if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const inputFile = process.argv[2] || 'examples/merchants-demo.json';
  const outputFile = process.argv[3] || 'results/merchant-priorities-demo.json';
  const result = prioritize(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(inputFile, 'utf8')));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outputFile), {recursive:true});
  fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
  console.log(JSON.stringify({output:outputFile,merchant_count:result.merchants.length,outreach_sent:false}));
}

import fs from 'node:fs';
const snapshot = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2] || 'data/creator-video-snapshot.json','utf8'));
const output = process.argv[3] || 'results/channel-summary.json';
const median = values => {const a=values.filter(Number.isFinite).sort((x,y)=>x-y);return a.length ? (a[Math.floor((a.length-1)/2)]+a[Math.ceil((a.length-1)/2)])/2:null;};
const groups = ['human_led_history','current_ai_series'].map(cohort=>{
  const items=snapshot.items.filter(x=>x.cohort===cohort);
  const published=items.filter(x=>x.published===true);
  const views=published.map(x=>x.views).filter(Number.isFinite);
  return {cohort,records:items.length,published:published.length,not_yet_public:items.length-published.length,
    published_views_sum:views.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),published_views_median:median(views),
    views_available:views.length,views_missing:published.length-views.length,
    earliest_publication:published.map(x=>x.publish_time_raw).filter(Boolean).sort()[0]??null,
    latest_publication:published.map(x=>x.publish_time_raw).filter(Boolean).sort().at(-1)??null};
});
const result={source:'creator-video-snapshot.json',comparison_type:'descriptive_snapshot_not_causal_model_comparison',
  limitation_zh_hant:'片齡、題材與流量來源不同，累積播放差異不能歸因於模型或營運者。',
  limitation_en:'Different video ages, topics, and traffic sources prevent attributing lifetime-view differences to the model or operator.',groups};
fs.mkdirSync('results',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(output,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');
console.log(JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
