A page can drop a row before the platform has agreed, and a list that loads only in part proves nothing by leaving a comment out, so none of the three is enough alone. The receipt keeps how each of the page's own requests was answered, by address and shape only, plus the plain status words and type names the site gives, each with the field it came from. A first real YouTube delete reached the expected address and named the comment, but its answer carried other fields than the expected success word, so it stayed `COMMENT_UNVERIFIED` although the reply left the page. Another action's success word, such as a pin's, does not count for a delete: it must appear at the delete's own field, which has not been seen yet. The receipt now keeps the names of an answer's nested fields (and, on Instagram, its plain type names), never anything a person wrote, so one more real delete can show what a success looks like. The one real Instagram delete went through `/api/graphql` and its answer named the comment, but which type name in the answer means success is not known yet, so it stayed `COMMENT_UNVERIFIED` as well, although a fresh read afterwards no longer listed the comment. Whether the comment left the page now goes by the comment's own link rather than its words, because another comment with the same words had spoiled that check. Until one more real delete on each platform shows what a success answer looks like, treat every YouTube and Instagram delete as unconfirmed and look on the platform. On X the reply's own page must say it no longer exists, on Bilibili it must no longer be in the page where it was found and that page's own count must show it holds every reply (Bilibili's own "no such comment" answer also settles it), and on Douyin the comment list must be read to its end. Whenever the receipt stays `COMMENT_UNVERIFIED`, check it with `comments verify-action RECEIPT_KEY` or on the platform, and never press delete again. A comment that is not on the page that loaded is refused before anything is pressed. Pinning/hiding boundaries are described below; bulk moderation is not implemented.

## Direct messages and platform differences

After first login, `dm` reuses the CLI's own sessions. Douyin, Instagram and X operate their official websites in the background, not standalone private APIs. The host agent writes **one language matching the recipient**. `--language` records that decision; it does not translate messages or detect every language.

```sh
vpub dm list instagram --limit 10
vpub dm read instagram EXACT_HANDLE --limit 20
vpub dm send instagram EXACT_HANDLE --file message.txt --language en
vpub dm send douyin MS4w_PUBLIC_PROFILE_ID --file message.txt --language zh
vpub dm send x EXACT_HANDLE --file message.txt --language en
vpub dm verify RECEIPT_KEY
vpub dm unlock x
```

| Platform | Message scope and limits |
|---|---|
| Douyin | Visible Creator Center conversation summaries; open, read and send text through an exact public profile. Supply the `MS4w…` ID after `/user/`, never a guessed nickname. Recipient restrictions and stranger-message limits still apply. |
| Instagram | Visible inbox summaries; open an exact handle's conversation and read/send text. Display names and similar search results are not recipient identifiers. |
| X | Visible X Chat inbox, exact-handle conversations and text sends. Use `dm unlock x` for the user to enter an official PIN in the dedicated window; the CLI does not read it. Closed inboxes stop sending. |
| Bilibili | Delegates to upstream `dm list/read/send`, retaining its new-contact restrictions; no Bilibili live tests in this round. |
| YouTube | No DM adapter; use the existing comment-reply workflow. |

`list/read` send no messages, but opening an official conversation can mark incoming messages read. Results cover visible entries, not complete history. Installation, login and `ops sync` do not message anyone. Explicit single-message tasks run directly within the user's authorization, with optional `--dry-run`.

The CLI saves account, recipient, preflight state and receipt before one submission, then opens a new session to read back the outgoing message. `DM_VISIBLE` means visible in the sender's conversation, **not recipient delivery or read confirmation**. Resolve `DM_UNVERIFIED` with `dm verify KEY`, never a resend. Repeating the same most-recent successful message also causes no new send. Official challenges, uncertain recipients and changed layouts stop execution. Private message bodies and recipients stay in local receipts; operations reports contain deduplicated states and counts only. Authorized tests use `--test-id LABEL` to stay out of normal reports.

### Pinning and hiding boundaries

`vpub comments pin bilibili BV_ID ROOT_COMMENT_ID` and `--remove` delegate to upstream for top-level comments only. Another pinned comment stops the command instead of being silently replaced; this round covers offline tests only. The observed Douyin and Instagram web layouts exposed no verified comment pin/hide control, so those actions are not integrated. X's profile pin is not comment pinning. Its hide/unhide route and live-test limits are described above. Other unsupported hide actions never substitute deletion, dislike or account blocking. Check `vpub capabilities`; one account's observed web limits are not a claim that the entire platform can never support a feature.

## Install and start

Requires Python 3.10–3.14 and Git for Git-URL installation. The [Windows installer](../install.ps1) finds compatible Python, creates an isolated environment and installs dependencies; missing Python must be prepared by the agent. The background browser routes require Google Chrome. Run `vpub setup --install-browser` if it is missing. YouTube API mode requires a Desktop OAuth client JSON; the other three routes do not need platform developer keys. A standalone model API key is not required.

```sh
pip install "git+https://github.com/whitecarp/publishops-crosscast.git"
vpub doctor
vpub onboard --platforms bilibili,douyin,youtube
vpub prepare final.mp4 --platforms bilibili,douyin,youtube --language zh-Hans --visibility public --ai-generated yes
vpub go final-crosscast
```

`vpub prepare` uploads nothing and says what to write. `vpub go` then puts the words in, fits the covers, checks the plan and publishes. The sections below are the same steps one at a time, for when you need to stop between them.

Choose platforms and automatic publication versus editorial review once. Gmail-only email stays off unless explicitly requested. Reuse authorization without repeated editorial approvals. `--confirm` is a plan-integrity hash. The CLI persists email settings; the host remembers editorial preferences.

For upgrades, uninstall the old `whitecarp-video-publisher` package first. The `vpub` command, `video_publisher` Python module and runtime/sign-in/job storage are retained; do not delete user data.

### YouTube API sign-in

This route needs the paid add-on; the free route needs no Google Cloud setup, only `vpub auth login youtube --method browser`. Enable YouTube Data API v3 in Google Cloud, create a Desktop app OAuth client and download its JSON. An API key alone cannot authorize uploads. If the project is in Testing mode, add your sign-in account under Google Auth Platform → Audience → Test users to avoid `403 access_denied`.

```sh
vpub auth login youtube --method api --client-json /path/to/client.json
vpub auth status youtube --method api
```

Open the printed official Google authorization link on the same computer running the CLI, choose your channel and grant access. The callback waits for five minutes. Keep client JSON and tokens local; never commit them to GitHub. Set the YouTube manifest's `method` to `api` to use this backend; signing in does not change existing manifests. First connection requests upload, read and video/playlist management permissions together for the user to approve in Google. Old upload/read-only tokens need one reauthorization. Permission does not authorize arbitrary deletion.

If authorization completes but API reads time out, run `vpub doctor`. The paid add-on's dependencies include [PySocks](https://pypi.org/project/PySocks/): without it, the Google client's `httplib2` transport can ignore a configured proxy. In an older environment, run `python -m pip install PySocks==1.7.1` with the same Python environment and retry the status query; do not reupload the video.

## Login once, publish through the CLI

```sh
vpub auth login youtube --method browser
vpub auth login x
vpub auth login instagram
vpub auth login douyin
vpub auth status all
```

Each first login (YouTube's free route included) opens CrossCast's own official Chrome window. Choose QR, password or another option offered by the site and complete any SMS/identity check yourself. Later commands run headlessly with the same local profile. This profile is separate from Codex's browser; no host cookies are exported. Sessions may expire or require verification again. A platform can treat CrossCast's own browser as a new device, so a first sign-in may bring a check or an account-recovery step. Finish it yourself on the platform's own page; CrossCast never answers it. If a check appears while a command is running, everything stops until a person has passed it and cleared the stop (see [safety limits](#safety-limits-for-replies-messages-and-likes)). Restarting the sign-in again and again doesn't help, and a saved profile can still be asked again later.

On Windows, an AI app installed as a package (most Microsoft Store apps are) gets its own private copy of `%LOCALAPPDATA%`, so a sign-in made through one such app doesn't appear in another: both see the same path, with separate contents. If a sign-in seems to be gone after switching apps, it probably hasn't expired. Sign in again from the new app, or set `VPUB_HOME` so both apps use a normal folder, such as `C:\Users\you\CrossCast-data`, and sign in once there.

`onboard` can start only the selected platforms. Existing manifests are not migrated automatically: set `method: browser` for Douyin/Instagram/X and for YouTube's free route (`method: api` for YouTube only with the paid add-on); `init` now supplies those defaults. `method: native` is the explicit host-agent fallback.

X/Instagram passed a fresh CLI read-back after restart. After reauthentication, several independent Douyin commands reused the session to read and edit episode two; long-term session stability remains unverified. See [validation](VALIDATION_EN.md).

## Copywriting and language

Routing follows the video's original content language, independently of account locale or GitHub documentation:

| Platform | Content language | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Bilibili, Douyin | Chinese, either script | Simplified Chinese only |
| Bilibili, Douyin | Any other language | Original language + Simplified Chinese |
| YouTube, Instagram, X | English | English only |
| YouTube, Instagram, X | Any other language | Original language + English |

Keep the source-language section first, then the target-language section. Matching-language content is not duplicated. Preserve voice, episode identity and events; shorten both sections together to fit limits. This does not translate audio, subtitles or text baked into artwork.

```sh
vpub metadata request publish.json --source script.txt --out request.json
# The host conversation model checks the script and writes response.json.
vpub metadata apply publish.json --request request.json --response response.json --out localized.json
```

Bilingual responses include two `description_parts`; `description` must join them with a blank line. The CLI validates order, mode and length. If the language is unknown, the host inspects the script/subtitles and sets `content_language` first; documentation language is not evidence.

`bili-cli` submits supplied descriptions; the host conversation model writes them. CrossCast adds structured requests and validation without reading hidden history or embedding a translation model. External links are off by default; irrelevant BV references are omitted while context and plain-text third-party credits/licenses remain. Schema checks do not prove translation quality.

## Production covers and original video

```sh
vpub covers prepare localized.json --source production/cover.jpg --portrait production/portrait.jpg --out-dir covers-v1 --out ready.json
```

Landscape roles prefer platform-specific artwork, then the production cover, using contain fitting. Douyin and Instagram portrait roles require one dedicated composition: explicit `--portrait` first, otherwise the manifest's Douyin/Instagram portrait. Both outputs preserve identical image bytes and SHA-256. Landscape padding is no longer a portrait fallback. Missing artwork prompts preparation rather than replacing originals.

No portrait artwork and no image generator? `vpub covers portrait` builds one with no AI, from parts of an image that the agent picks by looking at it:

```sh
vpub covers portrait production/cover.jpg --box 800,200,800,300 --box 0,0,800,900 --out production/portrait.jpg
```

Each `--box` is `x,y,width,height` in the source's pixels, top to bottom, up to three. The parts are enlarged and stacked in the central 3:4 area of a 1080×1920 cover, so Instagram's full frame and Douyin's crop both keep them, over a blurred copy of the source. It refuses a layout that would only fill a band across the cover (`would_letterbox`), never overwrites a file, and lists in `soft_parts` any part enlarged more than 2.5 times. Look at the result before passing it to `covers prepare --portrait`.

| Platform | Working canvas and application |
|---|---|
| Bilibili | 1600×1000; upstream CLI or native browser |
| YouTube | 1920×1080; API or Studio, possibly requiring official verification |
| Douyin | 1200×900 landscape + shared original portrait; CLI uploads both, and the portrait editor crops to 3:4 |
| Instagram | 1920×1080 web artwork + the same shared original portrait for the phone picker; original video ratio |
| X | Landscape artwork uploaded by the CLI through Media Studio; Studio access required |

These are working presets, not permanent platform specifications. Complete local artwork does not prevent platform cropping: inspect platform previews and profile thumbnails. Source SHA-256 is not a remote-byte hash of the platform's compressed file.

### Instagram publishing and covers

**Instagram retains original footage and Original crop, with a separate upload cover.** On a phone, Edit cover → Add from camera roll can select the same dedicated portrait used for Douyin. The 0.2.4 one-second lead-in experiment did not solve this requirement and was removed in 0.2.5. Preparation no longer modifies/transcodes video or requires FFmpeg.

```sh
vpub instagram prepare ready.json --out instagram-ready.json
# Add --mobile-cover production/portrait.jpg if the manifest lacks one.
```

On the phone, open Edit cover, choose Add from camera roll and select the shared portrait. Inspect both the cover and profile-grid previews before saving; different surfaces may crop different regions.

The handoff prefers an explicit `--mobile-cover`, then `covers.douyin.portrait`, then `covers.instagram.portrait`. It records the identical image path and hash; the user performs the mobile step. For future shared artwork, generally consider a 9:16 composition with titles, faces and essential text in a central safe area that also survives 3:4 crops. Avoid edges and UI overlays and inspect both platforms. This is a design guideline, not a guarantee of identical cropping.

**Episode-two shared cover accepted.** On 2026-10-30, the user applied v3 on Douyin and Instagram and confirmed both phone profile-grid screenshots. The footer now sits inside the visible area. Acceptance covers those two supplied views, not every device or display surface. Future artwork should retain shared safe areas and check text size, contrast, composition and playback-count overlays.

Use the production original in new plans, not retained 0.2.4 lead-in experiments. A CLI update does not replace, delete or repost existing publications.

[X Media Studio workflow](X_GUIDE_EN.md) · [Deletion and cover replacement](DELETION_AND_COVERS_EN.md)

For supported platforms, use the following handoff to edit an existing work, checking its original account, work ID and saved result. Instagram mobile covers and X Studio use the dedicated workflows above.

```sh
vpub browser cover RECEIPT_KEY --file landscape.jpg --portrait portrait.jpg --identity OBSERVED_ACCOUNT
```

## Playlists, categories and chapters

YouTube accepts `playlist_titles` (the free background route or native, ticked by exact title) or `playlist_ids` (paid API). The API checks membership before inserting and never blindly retries uncertain writes. The required management permission is included in first-time OAuth. Studio creation of a private list and selection for the existing work were verified; the API route remains mock-tested. On the free route, `create_missing_playlists: true` makes any of those titles the channel lacks, private, before the upload starts; one that already exists is left alone. Bilibili collections use `vpub collection`, and a Bilibili upload can join one with `season_id`, the exact ID from `vpub collection list bilibili`. The upload stands even if Bilibili refuses the collection, and the receipt says so.

New YouTube plans require an explicit `category_id`, selected from content and official choices rather than defaulting to People & Blogs. The host model can supply it via `metadata request/apply`; explicit selections are preserved. On the free route the ID must be one that Studio's menu offers (1, 2, 10, 15, 17, 19, 20 and 22 to 29); any other is refused with `invalid_category`.

A schedule is a `schedule` entry in a platform's part of the manifest: an ISO time with an explicit time zone, at least a minute ahead. Bilibili takes 2 hours to 15 days ahead through bili-cli. YouTube needs `visibility` set to `private` (Studio publishes it at that time) and uses the time zone Studio shows, otherwise this computer's. X and Douyin are described below. Instagram cannot be scheduled: a plan that asks for it is refused with `unsupported_schedule` before anything is uploaded, and the web composer of the one account that was checked showed no scheduling control. Plans with `method: native` and X's API route are refused the same way. On a real account a private Douyin schedule has been confirmed from its card and an X post has been scheduled and cancelled, and no schedule has yet reached its time.

X's browser route takes a future `schedule` too, with an explicit time zone. It fills Media Studio's own calendar and clock in this computer's time zone, reads them back and saves once. It reads Studio's schedule page once before the upload (`schedule_rows_before`). Before its time, one new row there with exactly its words, its date and time and a video makes it `SUBMISSION_VERIFIED` in phase `scheduled`, as Douyin's card does. A row has no ID and doesn't say which video, so the final press is tied to the file's own video beforehand, and an identical row added by someone else after that first read would pass too. If a row like it was already there, or the first read couldn't tell, it stays `SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED`, with the counts in `schedule_rows_with_its_words` and `schedule_rows_matching`. After its time, `vpub verify` confirms it only from one new post with exactly its words, at about that time, showing the video Media Studio numbered. If that number can't be read, it names the post as a `candidate_id` for you to check and stays `SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED`. On a real account a post was scheduled this way and cancelled before its time. The row check was written from what that run saw and hasn't itself run there. To cancel one, open that page, hover over its row, press its Delete, then the red Delete. CrossCast has no command for this, and the clip stays in the Library until you delete it.

Douyin's browser route takes a future `schedule` and a `collection_title`, the exact title of one of the account's collections. Both are filled on its own form and read back before 发布. The time is typed as this computer's clock shows it, but Douyin's page does not say which time zone its date box uses, so check the time Douyin shows afterwards. If Douyin does not keep them, the command stops before 发布 and the receipt's `final_submit_attempted` stays false. Before its time, `vpub verify` confirms a scheduled work only if it shows that time. A private schedule was saved on a real account and confirmed from its card, then removed before its time. A collection has not been saved there. Earlier versions could leave stray `*` in a caption with line breaks, and one real video showed them in its public description. That video has since been deleted, so no live example remains. Captions are now typed a line at a time, and the test card came out clean, but a new video's public page has not been checked.

`--draft-only` works on Bilibili and Douyin too. Bilibili saves through the requests its own upload page sends and reads its draft list back, ending in `DRAFT_SAVED`; CrossCast has no command to remove it, so delete it by hand on the 草稿 page of Bilibili's upload manager. Douyin presses its own 暂存离开 once and ends in `PREVIEW_READY`. Douyin shows no list of drafts, but its upload page may then offer a kept draft under 继续编辑. CrossCast only looks for that offer and presses nothing there, because opening an offered draft may use it up. The receipt records whether an offer that was not there before the upload was seen (`draft_offer_seen`), but an offer cannot show whose draft it is, and an older draft can show up late and look new, so it is not read back as this draft and Douyin is not counted in `drafts_read_back`. Before it selects any video, every Douyin upload (draft or not) looks at the upload page for up to three seconds, and if the page is already offering a kept draft it stops with `existing_draft_requires_attention`, because uploading now could replace that draft. Continue or discard that draft on the page yourself, then run the upload again. A draft keeps the title, description, tags and cover, so a plan that also asks for a schedule, chapters or a collection is refused. A plan with drafts reports two things. `all_drafts_ready` is true once every draft platform stopped before publishing (`DRAFT_SAVED` or `PREVIEW_READY`), and it sets the exit code: false exits 4. `drafts_read_back` names the platforms whose draft was read back as this draft, which today means only Bilibili (read back from its draft list). A platform that is not named there has only a preview, and an Instagram or X preview may not outlive its browser, so never call it saved. `all_submissions_verified` is `null` when no platform in the plan was meant to publish, so a draft never reads as a publication; in a mixed plan it covers only the platforms that were meant to publish. Bilibili drafts were saved this way on a real account, read back and then deleted by hand. On Douyin a draft was kept once, when `vpub resume` finished an earlier attempt: the upload page then offered it under 继续编辑, and a person who opened it found the exact test title. Opening an offered draft used it up once and left it in place another time, so do not assume either. A draft started from scratch later ended `PREVIEW_READY` on a real account with `draft_offer_seen` true and `drafts_read_back` empty, and a separate look found its test title. The stop for an offer already there before an upload has not run on a real account.

Douyin `method: browser` accepts measured `duration_seconds` and `chapters` in the publication plan. Once a durable published work ID is available, the CLI applies custom chapters, saves and reads each pair back; platform-generated suggestions are not treated as completion. Review delays leave a pending step, completed by later `vpub verify`/`resume` without reuploading. Native Bilibili/Douyin/YouTube handoffs remain available. Starts must come from the same final video, begin at zero and increase within its duration. Translate titles without altering timing.

Bilibili's CLI route and YouTube's browser route take `chapters` and `duration_seconds` too. Bilibili gets them through bili-cli right after the upload and reviews them. It only allows chapters on videos over a length it sets, and a refusal leaves the upload in place with `chapters_state: NOT_APPLIED`; `vpub verify` tries the chapters again without uploading again. `vpub verify` always reads first. If it's unclear whether the chapters arrived (`SAVE_UNVERIFIED`), it only reads, and it never overwrites a list someone else set (`CONFLICT`). To send them anyway, use `vpub edit`. YouTube makes chapters from timestamped lines in the description, so they are added there: at least three, each at least 10 seconds. Neither has been tried on a real account.

```json
{
  "duration_seconds": 78.506667,
  "chapters": [
    {"start_seconds": 0, "title": "A late reply"},
    {"start_seconds": 19, "title": "Memories in old comments"},
    {"start_seconds": 46, "title": "Speaking in my own role"},
    {"start_seconds": 57, "title": "Read before replying"}
  ]
}
```

These four timestamps are a historical episode-one example with user-confirmed mobile visibility at the time. The six custom episode-two chapters have now also been saved and fully read back through the CLI. See the [guide](CATEGORIES_AND_CHAPTERS_EN.md) for the chapter entry, 12-character title limit and review receipts. Description timestamps do not prove native chapters are active; missing access or review stays pending.

## Bilibili widgets

```sh
vpub widgets list BV1xx411c7mD
vpub widgets add BV1xx411c7mD widgets.json --dry-run
vpub widgets add BV1xx411c7mD widgets.json
vpub widgets verify BV1xx411c7mD
vpub widgets remove BV1xx411c7mD 123456 --dry-run
```

Put a `widgets` list in a Bilibili plan, or in a file for `vpub widgets add` on a video that's already up. Each has a `type`, a `time` in seconds and an optional `page` for the part number:

```json
[{"type": "link", "time": 10, "target": "BV1yy4y1k7yy", "text": "Next episode"},
 {"type": "follow", "time": 20, "style": "both"},
 {"type": "vote", "time": 30, "question": "Which one?", "options": ["A", "B"]},
 {"type": "rating", "time": 40, "title": "Rate this", "skin": "star"}]
```

Bilibili takes one vote on a video, and a widget shows for at least 5 seconds. A follow button also takes `x`, `y` and `duration`, and a vote takes `allow_custom` and `custom_label`.

- **When:** Bilibili doesn't list widgets before a video is public, so a plan's stay `WAITING_FOR_PUBLIC` and go out with `vpub verify` after that. A failed read is an unknown, and nothing is sent after it.
- **Sending:** each run reads first and sends only what isn't there, 35 seconds apart, then reads back. One that may have gone is `UNVERIFIED` and is only read again. `vpub widgets add --again` sends it once you've seen it isn't there.
- **Refusals:** Bilibili's 79046, a clash with another widget's time, leaves that one `REFUSED`, so give it another time. Its 36703, sending too fast, stops the rest and everything else on Bilibili, as any push-back from it does.
- **After an update:** `vpub verify` and a Bilibili edit report what's on the video as `widgets_seen`, with any it had and lost under `missing`.
- **Reserve widgets** are left out, in both directions, since removing one notifies everyone who booked it. Use `bili danmaku interact` yourself for those.

This route hasn't run on a real account through `vpub`. The same bili-cli commands have, by hand, on public videos.

## Edit an existing publication

```sh
vpub edit RECEIPT_KEY correction.json --dry-run
vpub edit RECEIPT_KEY correction.json
# Read back an uncertain save without saving again:
vpub edit RECEIPT_KEY correction.json --verify-only
# A work CrossCast did not publish: check its owner once, then edit it by platform and ID.
vpub ops adopt bilibili BV_ID
vpub edit-work bilibili BV_ID correction.json
```

Instagram caption edits read the original saved text from the existing work’s editor. Page translations, comments and old success receipts are not current-caption evidence. Matching text causes no save; a mismatch is corrected on the same work, then the editor is reopened for read-back. `vpub edit KEY PATCH --verify-only` checks without saving; `EDIT_MISMATCH` means the actual text differs and permits an explicit correction after inspection. After an unclear save, a check can only confirm it: anything else stays `EDIT_SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED`, because a page can show the old words for a while, and another save is refused with `inspect_existing_edit` until a person has looked at the work and you add `--person-approved`.

JSON requires `expected_identity` and exactly one group: full `title`/`description` with language fields (plus `tags` on Bilibili and Douyin), a Douyin `portrait` file, a YouTube or Bilibili `cover` file, or `chapters`/`duration_seconds` on Bilibili, Douyin or YouTube. Bilibili goes through the included bili-cli and reviews every edit again; it can drop an individual tag, which the receipt lists. YouTube uses Studio, or its API with the add-on. Instagram/X/Douyin use the CLI-owned session. On YouTube, chapters replace only the description's list of timestamped lines that starts at zero, and the rest stays. Saving a Bilibili edit has not been tried on a real account. Douyin caption saves have been tried on private test videos but have not been verified successful; works under review stop with `edit_held_by_review`. The separate save and read-back that succeeded through a script taking the same steps changed a cover, not the text; checking the existing text of a Douyin work, and of a Bilibili work whose description holds links, with `--verify-only` was confirmed there, with no write. New text that contains a web link is refused (`links_disabled`), but `--verify-only` compares what the work already says, links included, so a work whose description holds links can be checked against its own text. Video bytes and visibility are not changed. Receipts retain the work ID and block automatic retries after uncertain saves. Cover read-back provides a local screenshot for visual inspection; source hashes are not remote pixel comparisons.

On X and Instagram, an edit to a work published here follows its upload's AI declaration. A work adopted with `vpub ops adopt` has none to follow, so its new words say what its caption says now: a closing "AI-generated" line stays in its own wording, and none is added to a caption without one. X editing is attempted only when the original post exposes Edit. Missing access never triggers deletion, reposting or replies. The operator chose to keep episode two unchanged; the next post will follow the new language policy.

## Publication and receipts

```sh
vpub plan ready.json
vpub publish ready.json --dry-run
vpub publish ready.json --confirm CURRENT_PLAN_HASH
vpub verify RECEIPT_KEY
vpub works instagram
# X only: resume the existing Studio asset before final submission.
vpub resume RECEIPT_KEY
vpub receipts
```

Browser receipts persist the account, exact text, source hashes and final-submit flag. An uncertain submit is never automatically clicked again; `verify` can find a unique new matching work. After submission, `resume` verifies the original work and can complete its planned, unattempted Douyin chapter step; if YouTube's read-back shows the work is still a draft, nothing went public, so it presses Publish on that same draft; before submission it can continue the saved X Studio asset. Instagram/Douyin interrupted uploads require inspection of the existing draft. `works` lists the visible first page (up to ten Douyin cards), not a complete archive. Advanced native edits use `browser request/begin/record`.

An error code alone never shows that nothing was written: a command with several steps can submit before a later read or control fails. Before saying that nothing changed, or retrying, read that attempt's receipt. It is in the command's result when the command got that far, in `vpub status`, or from the matching verify command (`vpub verify`, `comments verify-action`, `comments verify-reply`, `engage verify`, `collection verify`, `playlist verify` or `dm verify`). Look at its `state`, whether it has a `submitted_at`, its `platform_writes` and, for an upload, `final_submit_attempted`, and at any read-back. A state that says submitting or unverified means it may have gone through: verify it and never repeat it.

**Codes an agent may meet.** Each says what happened, and the receipt still says what stands.

| Code or result | What it means | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| `write_spacing` | bili-cli held this write back to keep its own spacing, so nothing reached Bilibili. It waits through gaps of up to a minute by itself, so this means a longer one | Try again after its hint |
| `unsafe_text` | A title, description, tag or other public text looks like it holds a password, a key or sign-in data, so nothing went out | Rewrite it without them |
| `not_saved` in a `vpub verify` answer | Another command was running, or changed this record, during the check, so what the check read wasn't saved | Run `vpub verify` again |
| `attempt_exists` | This attempt at a reply has ended, or another got there first, so nothing more was sent | `comments verify-reply`; never send again |
| `attempt_replaced` | A newer attempt took this message, like or comment action over, or this one had already ended, so it pressed nothing | Read the newest attempt's receipt |
| `attempt_busy` | Another step was moving this attempt on at that moment, and nothing was sent | Try again shortly |
| `browser_step_timeout` | A step in the background browser ran out of time, and the message names the step | Read the receipt before anything else |
| `existing_draft_requires_attention` | Douyin's upload page is offering a kept draft, so no video was chosen | Continue or discard it on that page, then run it again |
| `ok: false`, exit 4 | The command ran but its work isn't finished: a change left waiting or unconfirmed, a platform's refusal, or chapters or a collection that did not land on a work that did | Follow the next command `vpub status` gives |

Templates default to public Bilibili/Douyin, private YouTube and account audience for Instagram/X; the host must apply user intent. Signing in never adds publication targets. Preparation, verification waits, platform review and public success are distinct; UI evidence and API verification have separate states.

## Optional email notifications: Gmail only

Email reminders need the paid add-on. Without it, the same notice appears in the command's result.

**Off by default; enable only when explicitly requested by the user.** Ordinary installation/login does not ask for an address or turn on email. This feature supports the host agent's Gmail plugin only: no Outlook, QQ, NetEase, SMTP or SMS.

Only after an enable request does the host ask for the user's own Gmail address. It checks the address and plugin, helps install a missing plugin or authorize an unconnected one, and allows cancellation with email left off. Before sending, the connected account must exactly match the chosen address. **Send from that account to itself only.** External service sign-in aliases are not treated as Gmail mailboxes.

```sh
# Run only when email is wanted; ordinary installation does not configure it
vpub notify configure --to you@gmail.com
# Disable at any time
vpub notify configure --provider off
```

The following is performed by the host agent; ordinary users do not edit JSON:

```sh
vpub notify inspect --email you@gmail.com --inventory host-mail-inventory.json
# A one-off test does not enable ongoing alerts; the same test-id never resends
vpub notify test --email you@gmail.com --test-id setup-test-001 --inventory host-mail-inventory.json
# Use the exact name of your assistant's own Gmail send tool; any assistant works
vpub notify claim RETURNED_ALERT_ID --available-tool YOUR_GMAIL_SEND_TOOL --inventory host-mail-inventory.json
# The host calls that tool once with the returned message, saves its response, then records it
vpub notify record RETURNED_ALERT_ID --claim-token RETURNED_TOKEN --response actual-send-response.json
```

Test messages are labelled TEST, with no fabricated sign-in incident. When official verification interrupts publishing, preserve the existing work and notify inline. Email queues only if enabled. The host must have a usable Gmail plugin at execution time; the CLI cannot send through it when the host is not running. Queued, sent and inbox-delivered are separate states. Timeouts or uncertain results never cause automatic retries. See [live validation](VALIDATION_EN.md).

## Backends and references

Bilibili uses the included copy of [kukemc/bili-cli](https://github.com/kukemc/bili-cli), which also gives you the `bili` command. YouTube uses a CLI-owned background browser on YouTube Studio, or its official API with the paid add-on. Douyin/X/Instagram use CLI-owned background browsers, with host-browser handoff as an explicit fallback. See [validation](VALIDATION_EN.md) for actual publication evidence and limits.


## Official API routes for X, Instagram and YouTube

These routes are a separate paid add-on, and YouTube commands below that use the official API need it too. The default browser routes stay free and need no developer app.

## Faster repeat commands

Comment, stats, like, message and other non-publishing browser commands now share one background browser per account, so later commands skip starting Chrome. It runs only on your computer over a private authenticated pipe, and it exits after 5 idle minutes, after 1 hour, after any error, or when `vpub stop` is used. YouTube's browser is a real Chrome window, so it is shared only on Windows, where it runs on a hidden desktop and closes after 20 idle seconds. On other systems each YouTube step starts and closes its own browser. Publishing, `resume`, `edit` and login close it first and run alone. A command that was already sent is never repeated automatically. When a step runs out of time, the error is `browser_step_timeout`, which names the step (starting Chrome, checking who is signed in, checking the page for a platform's warning, or running the command) and says a sign-in has not been shown to have expired; check any receipt before running the command again. On a shared browser a second command waits for the first instead of failing, for up to three minutes. A command that changes something, or a YouTube command outside Windows, started while another is running stops with `busy` or `browser_busy`: wait and run it again, and never delete a lock file. To turn this off, set `browser_idle_seconds` to 0 in the settings file or `VPUB_BROWSER_IDLE_SECONDS=0` in the environment.

While a browser command works it writes short JSON lines to stderr, one at each stage and at least every 15 seconds, so a slow command does not look hung: `{"event": "browser_progress", "platform": "youtube", "stage": "opening the page", "elapsed_seconds": 12.3}`. The stages are `waiting for the browser`, `starting the browser`, `checking the account`, `opening the page`, `reading the page`, `uploading`, `pressing`, `reading back` and `closing the browser`. They never hold anyone's words, names, IDs or addresses. Stdout stays the one JSON answer, so read the two streams separately.

## See what needs attention

```sh
vpub status
```

Its `actions` section lists every reply, message, like or save, comment action, collection or playlist change, edit and widget that may have gone out and isn't confirmed, newest first, each with the read-only command that settles it. It holds no message words and no recipient, so it's safe to show.

`vpub status` reads local records only, so it needs no sign-in and contacts no platform. It shows any active stop and its reason, each unfinished publication with the exact next command and how far its upload got, the drafts and previews it has a record of, running background browsers, pending messages, the last sync and how much disk the video copies use. Saved sign-ins it lists are not a live check; use `vpub auth status` for that.

When a browser command fails, CrossCast keeps a small local record of the step that failed and the kind of controls the page had (their type and technical name), with addresses stripped of their query strings. It never keeps what was typed into a field or the words the command was looking for, and a refused press says why in fixed words and names what was in the way by its tag only. Page text, control labels and pictures can hold private messages or name people, so they are kept only if you set `"page_diagnostics": true` in `config.json` while looking into a problem. The records are in the data folder: `operations\errors` (reads and collections), `edits` (corrections) and `browser-debug` (uploads). Turn the setting off afterwards, delete what it saved, and read any record before sharing it.

`vpub stop` pauses publishing and browser commands. The tool never clears a stop by itself: once a person has looked at the reason and dealt with it, `vpub stop --clear` lifts it (that removes the file `vpub stop` and `vpub status` name).

## Free up disk space

```sh
vpub cleanup
vpub cleanup --apply
```

Each publication keeps a private copy of the approved video, so a later edit cannot change what gets uploaded. The first command only lists what could go. `--apply` deletes a copy only when every publication using it is verified and the original video is still in place and unchanged, so it can never remove the last exact copy. Publishing the same plan to another platform later makes a new copy from the original.

核對日期：**2026-10-29**。下列為來源與設計判斷，不是實發成功證明。

## 內置瀏覽器

實測 YouTube 在 Codex 內置瀏覽器沿用現有登入；Instagram 也進入登入後首頁，能打開照片／影片選擇入口。這只證明本次帳號與介面，不能外推所有地區、帳號或 AI 客戶端。畫面轉接的 Google 登入原型已從發行程式移除。

## YouTube

官方 API 使用 OAuth 與 可恢復上傳，需要開發者端設定；本工具保留為選配，不把設定交給預設流程的觀眾。預設用宿主的官方 Studio 網頁。

來源： [桌面 OAuth](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/guides/auth/installed-apps), [可恢復上傳](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/guides/using_resumable_upload_protocol), [videos.insert](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/videos/insert).

Direct Post 需要應用與使用者授權，未通過審查的 API client 有私密可見限制；使用者要能預覽、選擇當前允許的受眾並同意上傳。因此，不能把「個人有帳號」說成「公共 API 發布已可用」。本次香港手機登入未成功，現已暫停全部 TikTok 適配，詳見 [狀態說明](TIKTOK_STATUS.md)。

來源： [Direct Post 前置條件](https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/content-posting-api-get-started), [內容分享要求](https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/content-sharing-guidelines).

## Instagram

Meta 官方 API 文件描述 Professional 帳號的內容發布，Facebook Login 路線另有 Page 關聯及權限要求。不能把普通網站登入當作 API 已授權。本次先用官方網頁，API 整合另列待辦。

來源： [Meta's Instagram API collection](https://www.postman.com/meta/instagram/documentation/6yqw8pt/instagram-api?entity=request-23987686-1ff01566-3509-48bd-a0f4-8571a91ccfdf). Meta 開發者部分頁面本次回傳 429／無法讀取，未將第三方教學當成官方現況。

## Bilibili／抖音

B站復用 bili-cli；抖音官方開放平台有應用能力和授權要求，另保留個人帳號網頁路線。早期版本曾用固定版本的 SAU 輔助填寫表單，現已移除；目前由本工具自己的瀏覽器路線填表、提交一次並保留回執。

來源： [bili-cli](https://github.com/kukemc/bili-cli), [抖音影片發布文件](https://open.douyin.com/platform/resource/docs/openapi/video-management/douyin/create/create-video), [social-auto-upload 固定版本](https://github.com/dreammis/social-auto-upload/tree/3847fff01f5434a8a32829833163cd6723cabc59).

## X（Twitter）

先提供官方網頁交接，不要求觀眾申請 API 金鑰。X 的單一帖文需要將標題、說明、hashtag 與 AI 聲明合併；實際文案計數和媒體規格由帳號頁面核對。回執使用 handle 與數字 status ID，驗證作者及網址一致。完整查詢／互動命令尚未實作。

來源： [X 網頁影片上傳](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos). 實作： [X 操作說明](X_GUIDE.md).

# Upload-route research

[繁體中文](RESEARCH.md) · **English**

Checked: **2026-10-29**. Sources and design decisions below do not prove live upload success.

## Native browser

YouTube reused an existing in-app session. Instagram reached an authenticated home page and a photo/video picker. This proves only the tested account/UI state, not all regions, accounts or agents. The Google screen-relay login prototype was removed from the distributed code.

## YouTube

The optional API uses OAuth and resumable upload with developer setup; default viewers use official Studio through the host browser.

Sources: [Desktop OAuth](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/guides/auth/installed-apps), [resumable upload](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/guides/using_resumable_upload_protocol), [videos.insert](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/videos/insert).

## TikTok (suspended)

Direct Post needs app/user authorization; unaudited API clients face private-viewing restrictions. Its UX requires preview, allowed audience choices and consent. Having an account does not establish public API publishing access. After an unsuccessful Hong Kong phone-number login test, all TikTok integration is suspended; see [status](TIKTOK_STATUS_EN.md).

Sources: [Direct Post prerequisites](https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/content-posting-api-get-started), [content sharing guidelines](https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/content-sharing-guidelines).

## Instagram

Meta's API documentation describes content publishing for professional accounts; its Facebook Login route adds Page linkage and permissions. A website login is not API authorization. This iteration uses official web UI, with API integration tracked separately.

Some Meta developer pages returned 429/unavailable; third-party tutorials were not treated as authoritative current behavior.

## Bilibili and Douyin

Bilibili reuses bili-cli. Douyin's open platform has app-capability/authorization requirements, while its official website offers an account workflow. Early versions used pinned SAU helpers to fill forms. They have been removed; this tool's own browser route now fills the form, submits once and keeps the receipt.

Sources: [bili-cli](https://github.com/kukemc/bili-cli), [Douyin video-create documentation](https://open.douyin.com/platform/resource/docs/openapi/video-management/douyin/create/create-video), [social-auto-upload pinned source](https://github.com/dreammis/social-auto-upload/tree/3847fff01f5434a8a32829833163cd6723cabc59).

## X (Twitter)

The initial route hands off to the official website without requiring viewer API keys. It combines title, description, hashtags and AI disclosure into one post; verify the actual site's character counter and media constraints. Receipts bind the handle and numeric status ID to the matching author URL. Unified query/interaction commands are not implemented.

Source: [X web video upload](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos). Implementation: [X guide](X_GUIDE_EN.md).

Related links: [Meta's Instagram API collection](https://www.postman.com/meta/instagram/documentation/6yqw8pt/instagram-api?entity=request-23987686-1ff01566-3509-48bd-a0f4-8571a91ccfdf)

# TikTok support suspended

[繁體中文](TIKTOK_STATUS.md) · **English**

Updated: **2026-10-29**

Our test could not complete TikTok sign-in with a Hong Kong (+852) phone number. The maintainer has therefore suspended TikTok integration. This records the observed test limitation; it is not an independently verified claim that every Hong Kong number or sign-in method is unsupported.

TikTok is removed from sign-in selection, `all`, and new publication templates. Old TikTok plans and unstarted jobs are blocked; historical receipts are retained. Douyin is a separate platform and remains in scope.

If you have a working TikTok account in another region and would like to help test using your own account, contact **[Bilibili channel (UID 10706217)](https://space.bilibili.com/10706217)**. Account owners should sign in themselves during testing; do not send passwords, SMS codes or cookies through GitHub issues, comments or messages.

This release does not support TikTok publication. Restoring the integration requires separate validation and a new release.

**此版本在真實帳號上的檢查包含讀取，以及在測試目標上進行的有限變更；都經擁有者同意，事後也都已復原或移除。** 下方的實測結果屬於各自列出的版本。2026-11-02 已透過這個版本的瀏覽器路徑發布公開作品，每一則都經擁有者同意：見「2026-11-02 真實公開發布」和「2026-11-03 真實公開發布」兩列。還沒有試過透過 bili-cli 1.2.1 發布。

| 實測 | 結果 |
|---|---|
| B站互動組件 | 手動執行，不是透過 `vpub`：2026-11-02 在兩部公開影片上以 35 秒間隔寫入四次，都回傳成功並讀回，每部各一個評分和一個關注按鈕。`interact list` 曾兩次失敗且沒有說明原因，在三部已通過審核、等待發布的影片上回傳 62003，所以 `vpub widgets` 會等到讀取有回應才動作。`vpub widgets` 本身只對替身程式跑過。 |

**已發布的 0.16.0 alpha 審計快照記錄了 2,066 項離線測試，CI 矩陣為 Windows 上的 Python 3.10、3.11 與 3.12。** 這是該發布快照的數量，不是持續開發分支的目前測試數。該快照另記錄付費附加元件自身的 210 項測試在此核心上通過；不是本次文件修正重新執行的結果。

|---|---|
| 重新啟動、重疊與當機 | 每次執行都是獨立程序，面對一個會記錄所有將送出內容的模擬平台。上限與重複檢查在重新啟動後依然有效。五個重疊執行只回覆同一則留言一次，六個也無法一起超過上限 2。送出後立刻被終止的程序不會再次送出（回覆、私信、按讚與留言按讚皆同）；送出前被終止的會退回計數。計數檔損壞時會停止送出，而不是歸零。每一種平台警告都會讓下一次執行停止，直到清除為止。 |

| 首次真實帳號實測 | 經擁有者同意，在 7f747c3 上執行。讀回符合預期：X 的作品、數據、回覆、按讚與書籤狀態及回覆預演；B站合集的清單、項目、建立、更名與刪除；YouTube 的作品、數據、留言、播放清單建立與刪除，以及影片按讚、儲存與復原。它也發現了問題，現已修正：關閉時卡住的瀏覽器會話使 X 被佔用超過一小時、X 的巢狀回覆視窗、失敗被回報為成功、分頁被取代後登入失敗、YouTube 的回覆框與上傳時的播放清單選擇器，以及移除儲存時先回報錯誤。後續實測重試了 YouTube 的修正。抖音的讀取起初逾時，結束舊版留下的卡住會話後全部通過。Instagram 在帳號更換裝置時要求復原帳號；擁有者復原後，它的讀取、收藏集的建立、更名、加入、移除與刪除、儲存與復原，以及還原得一字不差的貼文說明修改都通過。 |

X 有三次在發文前停止，因為上傳好的檔案打不開它的頁面；第四次是還沒選任何檔案，X 就要求驗證。之後一次草稿走到了 X 的發文框，正確檔案的資訊也填好了，未發布就刪除；接著一次排程用的上傳在同一個頁面等了十分鐘後停止，什麼都沒有排上。原因還沒有確認。現在依畫面上顯示的內容選檔案，等待逾時的錯誤會說明看到了什麼，也會指出 `vpub resume` 可以在新頁面重新查看，不必再次上傳。之後一次排程測試走到了 X 的日曆並按下它的 Save，但那只是確認日期，所以什麼都沒有排上；後續查看顯示真正的最後一步是寫著 Done 的按鈕。CrossCast 現在會按 Done，而且只在按鈕寫著 Done、日期時間與文字都讀回相符，並且都在這個檔案自己的表單內、圍繞這個檔案的影片時才按。一次全新上傳的草稿顯示該表單和它的發文框是同一部影片，未發布就刪除。接著一次排程測試按了一次 Done，Studio 的排程頁顯示一列，文字、日期、時間完全相符，也帶影片，沒有編號或連結。到點前已在那裡取消：滑到該列上、按它的 Delete，再按確認框裡紅色的 Delete（這個確認框沒有 dialog 角色），影片也刪除了。現在讀取這一列的檢查是依這次結果寫的，本身還沒有在真實帳號上跑過：下一次用來驗證它的上傳等了十分鐘檔案的表單後停止，什麼都沒有排上。當時檔案的詳情在原頁開啟但沒有表單，之後新的頁面只點一下就開啟了表單，所以影片已刪除。下一次上傳以同樣的方式卡住，網址仍在 Library。接著對同一份回執執行 `vpub resume`，48 秒就到了發文框，沒有第二次上傳，然後在按 Done 之前停止：說明有 532 個字元，有一個按鈕是灰的，原因還不清楚。那部影片也已刪除。現在檔案的詳情開啟卻沒有表單時，CrossCast 會再點一次檔案的方塊，這一點還沒有在真實帳號上跑過；那次停止現在也會說明是哪一項檢查沒通過。還沒有排程貼文真正走到發布時間。較早的兩次抖音私人排程都產生了正確的卡片，但都以未確認結束，第一次是因為在等一個該卡片不會開啟的頁面，第二次是因為卡片的字句裡有多餘的星號，每次都在到點前手動移除。一部私密抖音影片已發布，卡片和編輯頁文字都正確，擁有者看到的影片頁也沒有星號，但結果未確認，因為私密作品的標題點開沒有反應，所以找不到它的編號。改走卡片的編輯選單後，下一次私密測試已確認並認領成功。在它和之後另一部私密測試影片上修改說明，各按了一次都沒有存檔，測試影片之後都已移除。後一次的編輯頁顯示「作品修改審核中，暫不支持修改」，下方的儲存按鈕只是樣式變灰，仍可點擊但沒有作用。CrossCast 現在會讀取它，並在輸入或按下之前停止（`edit_held_by_review`）。第三部私密影片在第一次讀取時，也就是輸入或按下任何東西之前，這則訊息就已存在，約 49 分鐘後仍在；擁有者決定不再等待，影片未修改就刪除。抖音真實作品上的說明修改還沒有成功過。抖音的編輯頁也寫明每個作品最多修改 5 次。應擁有者要求修改一部真實影片的封面時，`vpub edit` 先停止了，什麼都沒有改變，因為標題欄會先短暫顯示空白。這一點已修正，還沒有在那裡重新跑過。接著，一個步驟相同的腳本在同一個背景瀏覽器裡發現，抖音的封面視窗接受新圖片後，按下「完成」30 秒（一次）和三分鐘（下一次）仍在處理，按鈕是灰的，什麼都沒有儲存；現在這種情況會以 `cover_not_ready` 停止。擁有者懷疑是網路問題，要求再試一次。這邊沒有做任何更改，一次「完成」和一次「提交修改」就回到了作品列表，重新查看時顯示新封面，標題、說明和可見範圍都沒有變，也沒有審核訊息。先前停止的原因還不清楚。這是第一次看到抖音真實作品的編輯頁儲存成功。YouTube 與 Instagram 的刪除留言確實移除了留言，但仍為 `COMMENT_UNVERIFIED`，因為還無法辨識平台的成功回應。 |
| 抖音的多餘星號 | 一次設定完整說明時，測試卡片上每個新段落開頭都出現 `*`，有一部真實影片的卡片、編輯頁和公開頁面都曾有 6 個。另一部真實影片沒有。現在說明改為一行一行輸入。下一張測試卡片上沒有這些符號，兩部私密測試影片的卡片、編輯頁和擁有者看到的影片頁也都沒有。修改現有說明還沒有成功，見上一列，那部真實影片的說明也一直沒有改正。這部影片後來已刪除，所以已經沒有線上的例子。新影片的公開頁面還沒有檢查。 |
| 安全測試 | 五個平台的每項免費功能都對模擬平台與頁面小型副本測試過，包含惡意訊息與頁面上的異常內容；發現 20 個問題，都已修正並附測試。Codex 的獨立審查也發現更多問題，已修正並附測試。安全審查與最終審查已在發布為 0.16.0 alpha 的檔案上結束，範圍以實際審查的內容為限。擁有者取消了另外在專用測試帳號上的試用，因此真實帳號上的證據僅限於這些實測列出的項目，從未在真實帳號上跑過的路徑仍標示為未試過。審查結束不代表每條路徑都試過。 |
| 抖音標題與簡介修改、YouTube 置頂、移除與章節、上傳時建立缺少的播放清單、X 刪除回覆 | 在真實瀏覽器中對頁面的小型副本測試。其中 YouTube 置頂、上傳時建立缺少的播放清單與 X 刪除回覆，之後在真實帳號上試過，見後續實測。抖音簡介儲存也已嘗試，但尚未驗證成功；另一次封面儲存成功不代表文字儲存成功。YouTube 移除觀眾留言與章節尚未在真實帳號上測試。 |
| B站合集 | 更名與成員清單的請求在獨立程序中執行，並以記錄器替換 bili-cli 的請求產生器，因此核對了確切的請求，也沒有任何內容送到 B站。更名的網址與欄位來自社群客戶端，並非 B站文件。更名已在上方的首次實測中於真實帳號上通過。CrossCast 自身的程序依然不會載入 GPL 函式庫。 |
| 直式封面 | 量測了 `vpub covers portrait` 的輸出：每個部分都在安全區內，邊緣沒有空白條，單一寬條會被拒絕，結果可作為共用直圖。版面好不好看仍需要人看過。 |
| 內含的 bili-cli | 全部 47 個檔案與 1.2.1 版相同。其測試套件在內含副本上通過（172 項通過、3 項略過）。CrossCast 組出的每條 `bili` 指令都對照真實指令樹解析。 |
| 全新安裝 | 建置好的 wheel 可安裝到空環境；`vpub doctor` 回報就緒，`bili --version` 回報 1.2.1。從獨立的 bili-agent 0.7.0 升級時，照 `vpub doctor` 的步驟處理後可正常使用。 |
| 背景瀏覽器 | 在空白頁上使用真實 Chrome，登入與指令以替身代替。1.6 秒啟動，復用會話 0.2 秒回應；忙碌時的指令會等候輪到自己，啟動競爭保留先啟動者，閒置退出後沒有殘留 Chrome。 |
| 格式錯誤的輸入 | AI 助手寫入的 JSON 檔案中若有錯誤值，現在會回傳清楚的錯誤。先前稽核發現的 32 條當機路徑現在為零。 |
| 文件與網站 | 所有文件中的指令都能解析，所有連結都有效。網站以三種語言在桌面與手機寬度下檢查，沒有溢出、主控台錯誤或破圖。 |

## 0.15.1：既有功能收尾

日期：2026-10-30。

**417 項離線測試通過，其中 15 項新增。** 新增檢查涵蓋跨程序互斥、硬退出後恢復、活躍／損壞的舊鎖、原回執保留、部分分頁重走、待辦封面與播放列表、封面結果不明不重送，以及延遲載入的 Instagram 編輯選單。

| 本輪實測 | 結果 |
|---|---|
| YouTube 強制中斷 | 私密片段於 8,388,608 位元組確認後 `os._exit(75)`；第二程序從原會話繼續，再於影片 ID 落盤後 `os._exit(76)`；第三程序完成封面。全程沿用同一影片 ID，讀回私密與處理成功。 |
| 測試清理 | 只刪除本輪私密測試片，重新查詢確認不存在；原影片、文案、封面與排期未修改。 |
| 文案與章節 | YouTube、Instagram 第二期的原中文＋英文文案與保存稿一致；抖音六個自訂章節再次逐項讀回。全部唯讀。 |
| Instagram 編輯 | 首次讀取因選單尚未載入而找不到 Edit；補上有界等待後，新程序從真正的作品編輯器核對雙語文案成功，沒有再次保存。 |
| 完整讀取 | 抖音／Instagram／X 空合集清單均讀到官方結束標記；YouTube 首頁預算暫停後續讀至結束。大型非空瀏覽器分頁仍未實測。 |
| 其他既有操作 | 發布、評論／回覆、讚／收藏、審核／隱藏、合集更名與成員增刪沿用下方歷次實測記錄。本輪未重做所有寫入測試，也未增加 B站測試。 |

**本輪範圍固定。** 不新增多帳號、歷史深度分析等方向。保留平台限制：抖音／Instagram 網頁不支援位元組續傳，其他瀏覽器作品／評論／私信歷史仍有界；Instagram 非空提及、大型清單與長時間無人值守缺乏驗收證據。手機封面沿用使用者已確認版本；X 第二期原帖依要求不動；Gmail 保持可選且預設關閉。下方為歷史記錄，舊版「待辦」不代表本輪新增承諾。

## 0.15.0：會話復用、上傳續傳與完整分頁

**402 項離線測試通過，其中 25 項新增。** 新增範圍涵蓋分塊／最後回應遺失、過期會話不另建上傳、帳號／影片／文案變更、目的網址核對、持久分頁游標、重複游標、跨頁去重、缺少回覆、伺服器結束標記與無關 GraphQL 回應。

| 實測 | 觀察結果 |
|---|---|
| 瀏覽器耗時 | 三次重新讀取 Instagram 合集：三個環境 37.312 秒，一個環境 17.297 秒；結果一致、沒有平台寫入。僅為單機單帳號樣本。 |
| 程序中斷 | 使用第二期片段做 YouTube 私密測試。伺服器接收 8,388,608 位元組後退出測試程序，另一個 `vpub resume` 程序接續同次上傳，讀回影片 ID 與私密狀態。臨時影片已刪除，稍後重新查詢確認不存在；原作品不變。 |
| YouTube 分頁 | 每頁 1 筆，兩頁讀取兩支既有影片。第二期評論及樓中樓共讀三頁，得到三筆唯一評論記錄；頁數預算可暫停，再從已保存游標繼續。 |
| YouTube 播放列表 | 每頁 1 筆，共四頁含重疊回應，去重後兩個列表；一個列表 1 筆成員，另一個列表五頁 5 筆。全程唯讀，未修改列表。 |
| 瀏覽器結束標記 | 抖音、Instagram、X 的空合集清單均讀到明確伺服器結束標記；臨時 Instagram 合集的空成員列表也核驗完整。大型、非空的多頁瀏覽器清單尚未實機驗收。 |
| 復用環境的寫入 | 臨時 Instagram 合集建立、更名、刪除均已保存。首次刪除讀回尚不明確，稍後唯讀核驗確認刪除，沒有再點一次刪除。所有臨時合集已清理。 |

首次 YouTube 建立會話時觀察到目前使用 `youtube.googleapis.com`，與文件中的 `www.googleapis.com` 不同；修正允許的官方主機後完成實測。首次嘗試未送出影片資料，保留其不確定回執。續傳網址只存本機。瀏覽器解析也修正了無關 GraphQL 空回應的誤判；真正來源格式異常仍會報錯。

未新增 B站實測、公開重發、互動訊息或修改既有封面／文案。瀏覽器作品／評論／私信完整歷史、瀏覽器位元組續傳、強制終止後鎖檔恢復及長期無人值守／大型帳號驗收仍待完成。下方舊版本段落為歷史記錄。

## 0.10.0：提及通知、觀眾審核與隱藏／恢復

通知預覽沒有平台事件 ID，完全相同的內容可能合併；有界可見區域不代表全部歷史。實測只代表指定帳號／頁面與樣本；沒有新增私信或 B站測試，沒有修改影片、封面、排期或 Gmail 設定。診斷頁面、留言正文及測試帳號資料保留本機，不公開。以下為歷史版本記錄。

## 0.8.0：評論管理與私信實測

**240 項離線測試通過。** 新增涵蓋私信待核驗時阻止重送、錯帳號／錯收件者拒絕、訊息氣泡的發送者與送出狀態、局部清單不降低原有同文訊息計數、單語參數、測試流量排除、抖音刪除不得以局部分頁缺席為成功，以及 B站置頂不得替換既有置頂。

| 本輪實測 | 結果 |
|---|---|
| 抖音評論點讚／取消讚 | 既有測試評論從未讚變成已讚，再恢復未讚；兩次以新的會話讀回確認。 |
| 抖音評論刪除 | 新建一條獨立、無回覆的自己測試評論，刪除後以完整評論頁確認缺席；保留原有「你好」對話。 |
| 抖音文字私信 | 對一個公開帳號發送一條中文測試訊息；新會話確認確切收件者及發出氣泡。 |
| Instagram 文字私信 | 對一個公開帳號發送一條英文測試訊息；新會話確認作者、正文及對話對象。 |
| X 文字私信 | 使用者自行完成官方 PIN；新 CLI 會話可復用。關閉收件匣的帳號未發送，改以另一公開帳號測試一條英文訊息；新會話讀回 You 標記及 sent 狀態。 |
| 收件匣摘要 | 三個瀏覽器平台均以 CLI 讀取可見摘要；不等於完整歷史、未讀總量或私人 API。 |

三站各發送一條訊息，沒有批量發送；不宣稱對方已收到或已讀。初次讀回無法確認的訊息保留為待核驗，修正辨識後只做唯讀核驗，未重新發送。抖音刪除確認對話的按鈕辨識修復也只在最終確認前重試。私信、原始頁面及收件者資料只留本機，不上傳 GitHub。

**B站本輪沒有線上測試。** 私信／評論置頂委派上游，僅完成離線檢查。抖音／Instagram 評論置頂與隱藏沒有可驗證網頁入口；X 隱藏回覆尚未接入，個人主頁置頂不能代替評論置頂。YouTube 既有評論功能保持，本輪未新增私信或審核 API。影片、封面、配文、排期、郵件與其他營運執行者不屬於本輪變更。

以下保留各歷史版本的原始驗收範圍；舊版「尚未支援」描述不覆蓋上述 0.8.0 結果。

## 0.7.0：批次讀取、持久收件匣與評論管理

五平台第二期作品的評論與數據均以 CLI 成功讀回；本輪約 **76 秒**，三個網頁後端共 **3 次瀏覽器會話**，唯讀巡檢無平台寫入。批次按同平台／帳號合併，Instagram／X 在同一作品頁讀評論與數據。此數字是單次開發實測，不是跨機器速度保證，亦未進行相同網路條件的前後耗時對照。

| 實測 | 結果 |
|---|---|
| B站、Instagram、X 評論點讚 | 各完成改變狀態、相同指令不寫入、恢復原狀態；獨立讀回確認 |
| YouTube 自己的評論 | 編輯既有測試回覆並恢復原文；另外建立一條可刪除測試留言，刪除後以確切 ID 查無結果 |
| 本機收件匣 | 已處理標記在重新同步後保留，測試後恢復原標記；YouTube 重讀新增觀眾評論為 0 |

共核驗 **9 次評論管理寫入**，另有 1 次專用測試留言建立；三次重複點讚指令為 `NO_CHANGE`。原有「你好」測試樓保留，觀眾評論未修改。Instagram 首測因文字與愛心為相鄰容器而在寫入前停止；已修正為確切評論容器定位並通過實測，禁止爬升至作品工具列。一次本機鎖衝突在提交前停止，待前一項完成後才測試。

**218 項離線測試通過。** 覆蓋只讀批次拒絕寫入、失敗停止與保留先前結果、帳號隔離、歷史保留與狀態重開、回覆補讀上限與續頁、確切作品／作者核對、未確認操作不重送、單條評論控制項與報告排除自測。回覆預覽補讀分支經回歸測試；這次真實樣本沒有不完整預覽，不能聲稱已實測大量評論樓。

本版仍沒有抖音評論管理、置頂／隱藏、私信或完整帳號收件匣。瀏覽器採集只包含可見評論。本輪沒有修改影片、封面、配文、可見性或排期；語言規則及 Gmail 預設關閉保留。私人回執與頁面診斷未公開。

官方參考：[YouTube 評論編輯](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/comments/update)、[評論刪除](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/comments/delete)、[評論讀取](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/comments/list)。

## 0.6.0：點讚、收藏、撤銷與去重

在使用者授權下，對各站既有第二期作品進行有限 CLI 實測。每種操作先保存原狀態，改變一次，用獨立讀取確認；再重複同一命令確認 `NO_CHANGE`，最後恢復原狀態並重新查詢。測試標記保留在私人回執，排除於一般營運匯報，不視為自然互動或流量增長。

| 平台 | 點讚與撤銷 | 保存與移除 | 驗證方式 |
|---|---|---|---|
| B站 | 通過，已恢復 | 指定收藏夾通過，已恢復 | 上游 CLI 關係狀態＋帶影片上下文的收藏夾成員查詢 |
| YouTube | 通過，已恢復 | 指定自己擁有的播放列表通過，已恢復 | `getRating` 與精確影片／播放列表成員 ID |
| Instagram | 通過，已恢復 | 預設 Saved 通過，已恢復 | 關閉並重新啟動 CLI 瀏覽器，讀取作品工具列 |
| X | 通過，已恢復 | 私人書籤通過，已恢復 | 指定帖文控制項，獨立 CLI 瀏覽器讀取 |
| 抖音 | 通過，已恢復 | 預設收藏通過，已恢復 | 正常作品頁載入的 `aweme_detail.user_digged`／`collect_stat`，核對精確影片 ID |

五站共 **20 次含恢復操作的寫入已讀回確認、10 次重複指令返回 `NO_CHANGE`**，點讚與保存狀態均已還原至測試前。保留失敗讀取與修正記錄，沒有用重複點擊湊成功結果。原有播放列表項目與其他收藏夾成員未被移除。

Instagram 實測修正了巢狀 section 的重複匹配，限定到最內層作品工具列，避開評論的讚。X 有一次作品已出現但工具列仍未載入，唯讀查詢停止；新增有界等待後，書籤添加、重複命令及撤銷均完成。YouTube 移除精確 playlist item，B站移除僅指定一個收藏夾。

抖音實測發現點讚後提示仍是「點讚」，原判斷把已成功操作標為待核驗。修正後從正常頁面自己載入的作品詳情讀取帳號狀態，獨立核驗原回執，沒有再次點讚。提示文字僅定位控制項，不再推斷狀態，也不用紅心顏色或總讚數猜測。這是觀察官方頁面回應，不是獨立官方 API；缺少欄位、影片 ID 不符或非 0／1 狀態會停止。

**193 項離線測試通過。** 新增狀態去重、持久提交、逾時後阻止重送與反向切換、帳號／收藏夾核對、重複列表成員停止、報告測試流量隔離，以及七項不連平台的 DOM 測試。本輪沒有重傳影片、改文案／封面／可見性或排期；既有語言與 Gmail 預設關閉規則保留。這是目前帳號與頁面的開發實測，不代表所有帳號、頁面或乾淨安裝的無人值守驗收。

官方參考：[YouTube 評分](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos/rate)、[評分讀取](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos/getRating)、[播放列表成員](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/playlistItems/insert)、[X 書籤](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/bookmarks)。YouTube 評分 API 的成功與官方讚數不是同一指標；本次驗證帳號評分。原始頁面、私人回執與登入資料不公開。

## 0.5.0：多平台唯讀巡檢

以目前登入帳號及既有第二期作品實測，全部透過 CLI 執行，未使用宿主內置瀏覽器。五站 `works` 均返回作品；YouTube／B站新增作品分頁與 `comments replies`，已讀回原有「你好」留言及回覆。沒有重新發送測試留言，也沒有變更影片、文案、封面、可見性或 B站排程。

五部作品加入本機追蹤清單後，`ops sync` 成功完成全部評論讀取及數據查詢：B站、YouTube、抖音、X 有可用數值；Instagram 當前作品頁沒有可用數值，保留 null 並在匯報中說明。自己的留言不計為觀眾互動。瀏覽器評論仍是可見範圍，B站頂層清單仍包含回覆預覽，沒有把這次巡檢寫成完整歷史收件箱。

YouTube 與 B站作品列表已實際翻至下一頁；第二次 API 巡檢新增評論數均為 0，未重複計數。實測亦發現 X 顯示零評論仍可能載入對話列，因此三個瀏覽器平台一律保留 `complete: false`。

**164 項離線測試通過。** 新增分頁上限與游標循環、重複項去重、帳號切換停止、部分失敗保留、來源／單位／約數不相容、百分點差值、追蹤清單及唯讀呼叫測試。實測只涵蓋目前帳號、作品和頁面，不能外推成所有帳號或乾淨安裝的無人值守驗收。觀看時長、完整 Insights、私訊及自動點讚仍未整合；Gmail 仍預設關閉。

API 參考：[YouTube 上傳列表分頁](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/playlistItems/list)、[評論回覆分頁](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/comments/list)。

## 0.4.1：修復抖音回覆與讀回

使用者在手機確認只有原留言。公開作品頁的發送請求沒有產生可讀回的回覆；改為創作者中心的指定留言回覆框，避免誤用頁面頂部的新增留言框。後台新鮮回傳確認原留言回覆數為 0 後，進行有記錄的修復測試，沒有再次建立頂層測試留言。

**已成功回覆並由獨立 CLI 會話讀回。** 新評論 ID、作者、原文「你好」和巢狀父留言皆匹配；另以官方頁自行載入的評論資料交叉核對。修復前的失敗回執保留。影片、簡介、封面、可見性及排期未改動。不是僅憑 HTTP 200 或點擊結果判定成功。

同時修正抖音缺少絕對時間時的核驗錯誤，辨識子評論的父留言，並區分平台拒絕、發送未確認與可見性核驗。回覆目標與創作者中心可見列不能唯一對應時停止；目前只支援回覆頂層留言。沒有新增自動重送機制；本次是使用者回報與新鮮後台資料支持的受控修復。

**147 項測試通過。** 新增同作品／父留言／作者／文字核對、空回執與拒絕、不覆蓋修復歷史、巢狀 DOM 與無絕對時間回歸。五站自測留言與回覆均已讀回；這是開發期實測，不能外推為所有帳號、頁面或乾淨安裝的完整無人值守驗收。

## 0.4.0：評論、回覆與營運匯報

使用者明確授權在既有第二期作品發送「你好」並回覆「你好」。沒有改動影片、封面、簡介、可見性或 B站排期；測試留言保留，未自動刪除。

| 平台 | 實測結果與證據邊界 |
|---|---|
| B站 | bili-cli 發送測試留言及回覆；讀回作者、原文、父評論和回覆 ID。原有觀眾留言已由作者回覆，沒有再次處理。 |
| YouTube | 官方 Data API 發送留言及回覆，讀回確認。實測修正：Comment 資源可能沒有 videoId，改以 CommentThread 驗證作品歸屬；不能只核對頻道相同。 |
| Instagram | CLI 專用會話點擊指定留言的 Reply 並發送；新評論 ID、作者與「@作者 你好」文字讀回。修復相對時間造成定位變動及 Post 按鈕延後出現。平台 API 父評論關係未驗證。 |
| X | CLI 專用會話發送留言及回覆，新帖 ID、作者和正文讀回。修復延後出現的巢狀對話框及 Draft.js 中文輸入；原影片帖文不變。平台 API 父評論關係未驗證。 |
| 抖音 | 測試留言已在公開作品頁讀回；創作者後台一度未顯示。回覆提交後尚未讀回確認，保留 REPLY_UNVERIFIED，沒有重送；此為當時狀態；後續修復見上方 0.4.1。 |

五站各有一次作品數據實讀：B站創作者數據、YouTube 基礎 statistics、抖音後台指標、X 帖文計數、Instagram 可見欄位。Instagram 未顯示的數值保留 null；沒有接入完整 Insights。YouTube 完播與觀看時長仍需獨立 Analytics 接入；X 的帖文瀏覽不能當成影片播放。調試訪問與自測留言可能影響平台原始計數，不作自然增長或提效證據。

已生成中文／英文自然段匯報，從真實回執取數並去重；作者留言及自測回覆不計入觀眾互動。不確定發送不算完成。回覆只跟隨評論者語言，匯報另外跟隨使用者語言。

**140 項離線測試通過。** 涵蓋分頁不漏項、作品歸屬、單語路由、直接發送、防重送、父評論核驗、缺值與指標口徑、自測隔離、匯報，以及兩項不訪問平台的 Chrome DOM 測試。實發是在開發中修正後完成，不等於乾淨安裝的一次無人值守驗收；抖音回覆仍是待驗項目。瀏覽器等待非同步提交的修正未新增一次實發測試。

官方介面依據：[YouTube 回覆插入](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/comments/insert)、[評論串分頁](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/commentThreads/list)、[影片統計](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/videos)。原始頁面、觀眾資料、登入資訊與私人回執保留本機，未公開。

# Validation status

[繁體中文](VALIDATION.md) · **English**

Date: **2026-11-02**, PublishOps CrossCast **0.16.0 alpha**.

## 0.16.0: paid API split, included bili-cli, status and cleanup

**Real-account checks for this version covered reads and a bounded set of changes on test targets, run with the owner's go-ahead and undone or removed afterwards.** The live results further down belong to the versions they are listed under. On 2026-11-02 public works went out through this version's browser routes, with the owner's go-ahead for each: see the "Real public posts" rows for 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03. Publishing has not been tried through bili-cli 1.2.1.

| Live check | Result |
|---|---|
| Real public posts, 2026-11-03 | With the owner's go-ahead for each: the film on `69aa590`, the game video on `066c49f`. **Posted and read back by CrossCast itself:** the 2:56 film on Instagram, with one upload, one Share and the full bilingual caption read back; and a 3:00 game video on YouTube, X and Instagram, two platforms at a time, each with one upload and one final press. X couldn't take the long bilingual caption, so the owner chose a short post with the credits in two replies, both read back. **What these runs found:** X rejected the overlong bilingual text only after the upload; YouTube's final Save can time out after a successful publish; finding the X post by its title missed a shortened post; and fixed pairs left a slot idle for 85 s. PRs 15–18 added fixes after these runs; those changes have offline test coverage, but have not been validated on a real account since. |
| Real public posts, 2026-11-02 | With the owner's go-ahead for each, on commits up to `d28cd22`. **Posted and read back:** a vertical video on YouTube, Douyin and X, and a 2:56 film on YouTube and X. The film also went up on Douyin with its cover: the owner saw it on their profile, and CrossCast's read-back lost its browser after the one press. The vertical video also went to Instagram, where an independent read accepted the post and CrossCast's own record stayed `SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED`. **What these runs found.** YouTube: the film's first Publish left a draft, with the form still open after the wait. Public uploaders show Studio asking "still checking your content" at that point, which wasn't captured here. Reopening that draft after its checks had finished and pressing Publish once put it up with no second upload. CrossCast now handles both, and that code hasn't run on a real channel. A vertical video's first try had stopped at its `/shorts/` link and left a draft, finished the same way. Douyin: one run's first page stayed empty with nothing sent, which now gets one more load. X: a first click right after a large upload opened the file's details with no form, and a new page with one click reached it. Date: 2026-10-30.

**417 offline tests pass, including 15 new tests.** Added coverage includes cross-process exclusion, hard-exit recovery, active/damaged legacy markers, preserved receipts, partial replay retention, pending thumbnail/playlist steps, uncertain thumbnail outcomes without resending and a delayed Instagram edit menu.

| Live check | Result |
|---|---|
| YouTube hard interruption | A private excerpt called `os._exit(75)` after 8,388,608 acknowledged bytes. A second process continued that session and called `os._exit(76)` after saving its video ID. A third completed its thumbnail. The same ID was retained; private visibility and successful processing were read back. |
| Cleanup | Only this private test clip was deleted, with fresh absence confirmation. Original videos, captions, covers and schedules were unchanged. |
| Captions and chapters | Episode-two YouTube/Instagram captions matched the saved Chinese-plus-English copy. All six custom Douyin chapters were freshly read back. No writes. |
| Instagram editor | The first check reached the menu before Edit loaded. After a bounded wait was added, a fresh process verified the actual work editor's bilingual caption without saving it again. |

| Other existing actions | Publishing, comments/replies, likes/saves, moderation/hiding and collection rename/member changes retain the historical live evidence below. This round did not rerun every mutation or add Bilibili tests. |

The user-accepted mobile cover is retained; the original X episode-two post stays unchanged; Gmail remains optional and off by default. Older pending notes below are historical, not new commitments.

The temporary video was deleted and a later fresh read confirmed absence; originals stayed unchanged. |

The allowlist was corrected before successful testing; that initial attempt sent no video bytes and its uncertain receipt is retained. Session URLs are private. No new Bilibili live test, public repost, interaction message or existing cover/metadata change was made.
