# X：CLI Media Studio 發布

**繁體中文** · [English](X_GUIDE_EN.md)

**X 的免費瀏覽器發布路徑僅面向已訂閱、且帳號實際能進入 Media Studio 的使用者。** 官方 API 路徑屬於另售的付費附加元件，目前尚未開賣；這不代表一般免費帳號或 Basic 帳號已受支援。

原因是未訂閱帳號的影片上傳上限為 **140 秒、512 MB**，且無法使用免費瀏覽器路徑所依賴的 Media Studio 媒體管理與自訂封面流程。CrossCast 的 X 免費瀏覽器後端透過 Media Studio 上傳影片並設定製作封面，因此目前僅支援具備此權限的訂閱帳號。登入或付款本身不代表權限已開通，上傳前仍會核對媒體庫入口與所選帳號。[官方上傳限制](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos) · [Media Studio 權限](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio)。

**0.3.1 alpha：** 首次 `vpub auth login x` 開啟官方登入視窗。之後 `publish` 在背景復用 CrossCast 專用會話：核對帳號 → 上傳 Media Studio → 套用製作封面 → 填入按原語言規則產生的完整帖文 → 提交一次 → 讀回原帖。這是程式操作官方網站，不是 X API 用戶端。X 可能把 CrossCast 的專用瀏覽器當成新裝置，要求檢查或找回帳號：請你自己在 X 的頁面完成，CrossCast 不會代為回答。

```sh
vpub auth login x
vpub auth status x
vpub init --video final.mp4 --language zh-Hans --platforms x --out x.json
# 宿主準備英文內容的英文文案，或其他內容的原文＋英文，以及製作封面。
vpub plan x.json
vpub publish x.json --confirm CURRENT_PLAN_HASH
vpub verify RECEIPT_KEY
vpub works x
```

用 `expected_identity` 綁定目標帳號。上傳前檢查 Studio 權限及其管理中的帳號。處理或選擇器在 Post 前失敗時，`resume KEY` 可接續既有素材；Post 後只驗證。方案也可以用 `existing_media_url` 指定 Media Studio 裡某個素材自己的頁面，這樣就不上傳，直接發布該素材，前提是頁面上的檔名是這部影片的 `crosscast-<雜湊>`。既有回執阻止重傳。`--draft-only` 停在預覽，不保證關閉瀏覽器後仍是持久草稿。此路徑沿用帳號受眾，不修改受保護帳號設定。

製作封面與第二期發布已實測，修復及限制見[驗證記錄](VALIDATION.md)。自訂縮圖需要真正可用的 Media Studio，訂閱本身不是成功保證。Studio 未觀察到原生 AI 標示控制，因此保留明確的 AI-generated 文字聲明。

## 支援條件與官方限制

本專案的免費瀏覽器發布路徑目前只適配具有實際 Media Studio 存取權的訂閱帳號，不以免費帳號的短片額度作為本後端的支援承諾。X 官方一般網頁上傳說明列出非訂閱帳號上限為 140 秒、512 MB；Media Studio 的自訂封面與媒體管理需要另外符合存取權限。[一般上傳限制](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos) · [Media Studio 權限](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio)。

現行官方級別表的傳統 Basic 不含 Media Studio，Premium／Premium+ 包含；平台亦有其他新方案，最終以帳號實際權限為準，不保證所有付費方案都適用。[官方級別說明](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-premium)。核對日期：2026-10-30。

## 排程、書籤夾與 X 的兩個網站

- **排程。** 在方案的 X 項目裡填一個帶明確時區的未來時間 `schedule`。CrossCast 在 Media Studio 自己的日曆與時鐘上，依這台電腦的時區填入並讀回，只保存一次。CrossCast 會在上傳前先讀一次 Studio 的排程頁。到點之前，如果那裡多出一列文字完全相同、日期時間相符且帶影片，回執就是 `SUBMISSION_VERIFIED`，階段為 `scheduled`。這一列沒有編號，也看不出是哪部影片；如果別人在第一次讀取之後加了一模一樣的一列，也會通過。如果原本就有相同的一列，或第一次讀取無法判斷，就維持 `SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED`，直到你親自查看。時間過後，`vpub verify` 只有在找到一則字句完全相同、時間相近，且影片與 Media Studio 編號相符的新貼文時才會確認；讀不到該編號時，會把貼文列為 `candidate_id` 供你查看。在唯一檢查過的真實貼文上，帶自訂封面的影片讀不到這個編號，所以這項核對只會列出候選，不會確認。在真實帳號上，有一則貼文這樣排程後，在到點前取消了；這項對列的檢查是依那次看到的內容寫的，本身還沒有在真實帳號上跑過。還沒有排程貼文真正走到發布時間。要取消時，打開那個頁面，滑到該列上，按它的 Delete，再按紅色的 Delete。CrossCast 沒有這個指令，影片也會留在 Library，直到你刪除它。API 路徑也不能排程。
- **直式影片的封面。** 在一則真實貼文上，3:4 的封面以 900×1200 儲存，但公開貼文以影片的 9:16 畫面顯示，標題兩側都被裁掉。重要的字不要靠近邊緣。橫式影片的 16:9 封面還沒有在公開貼文上核對過。
- **影片長度。** 如果方案的 X 項目有 `duration_seconds`，CrossCast 在撰寫貼文前會核對檔案的影片是否顯示這個長度（誤差一秒內），做不到就以 `video_unverified` 停止。不檢查畫面大小，因為 1920×1080 影片的預覽是以 480×270 播放的。
- **兩個網站。** X 有兩個版本的網站，CrossCast 會判斷帳號使用哪一個；到目前為止，已登入的帳號使用的是舊版。兩種都對不上的頁面會報錯停下；請看那次嘗試的回執（`state`、`submitted_at` 和 `platform_writes`）確認有沒有東西已經送出。
- **書籤夾** 需要 X Premium。在舊版上，列出、建立、更名、刪除書籤夾與把貼文加入書籤夾已在真實帳號上確認（第一次加入時 X 那邊已經加進去了，但 CrossCast 因為等不到 X 的回覆就放棄等待，回報為未確認；這個等待已經修好）。把貼文移出書籤夾要透過書籤夾頁面自己的分享選單；這手動做成功過。透過 CrossCast 試過兩次：第一次在背景瀏覽器裡逾時了，還沒記下任何東西；第二次按了一次，結果卻沒能確認，因為 CrossCast 去讀回結果時頁面上找不到書籤夾的控制項（多半是頁面重繪了一下；現在控制項會多給一點時間重新出現）。之後透過 CrossCast 再試一次已確認，另外讀取時書籤夾也是空的。
- **草稿。** `vpub init --draft-only` 停在發文編輯器的預覽，媒體已存進 Media Studio（`PREVIEW_READY`）；這不是已確認保存的草稿。

## 歷史 native 瀏覽器指南

以下為先前由宿主操作的測試記錄，目前 CLI 支援以上方說明為準。

**繁體中文** · [English](X_GUIDE_EN.md)

本版提供 **內置瀏覽器交接**：登入網址、單一帖文文案、帳號核對、檔案快照、單次提交與回執校驗。Agent 仍須實際操作官方網站；沒有獨立 X API 發布器；一條原創影片已發布並在登入頁讀回，完整播放尚未驗收。

**0.2.2 實測** 影片達 Ready，保存到 Unsent posts 並重新開啟，英文文案、影片及 Made with AI 保留。其後依使用者明確授權從同一草稿發布，原帖已讀回，未刪除。僅自己可見的測試使用 `vpub init --platforms x --draft-only`，此時禁止下方一般流程的最終提交。詳見 [草稿指南](DRAFT_TESTING.md)。

```sh
vpub onboard --platforms x
vpub init --video final.mp4 --out x-publish.json --platforms x
# 修改帳號與文案
vpub plan x-publish.json
vpub publish x-publish.json --confirm CURRENT_PLAN_HASH
```

在平台選項加入 `expected_identity`，值為登入後個人檔案可見的 handle（不含 `@`）。同一瀏覽器確認帳號後才執行 `browser begin`；登入方式由使用者自行選擇。

- **文案：** `plan.platforms.x.post_text` 依序組合標題、說明與 hashtag；`ai_generated: true` 附上 AI 生成聲明。上傳時使用完整 `post_text`，不要重組或截斷。
- **受眾** `visibility: account` 遵循帳號和頁面當前受眾。不是每條影片的「僅自己可見」，不自動修改帳號公開／保護設定。
- **規格** 以網站的文案計數器、影片檢查和帳號權限為準；中文、emoji、網址不能用 Python `len()` 當成 X 的正式計數。Agent 先核對影片時長、大小與格式，有不符即停止，不自動裁片或假設有付費權限。
- **提交** 等待影片處理完成、核對全文與受眾，再點擊一次發布；不確定結果只檢查原帖。
- **回執** 讀回 `https://x.com/HANDLE/status/ID`，記錄數字 ID、原帳號、全文 `post_text` 與各來源欄位。校驗器拒絕另一帳號的網址、不同 ID 或遺漏 AI 說明的全文。

X 官方網頁上傳說明目前列出：未訂閱帳號最多 140 秒、512 MB；付費帳號有不同額度。這是查閱日期的參考，實際帳號介面仍須驗證。

這個 native 交接流程本身不含搜尋、作品清單、數據分析、評論與收件箱；現在它們是各自獨立的命令（`vpub works x`、`vpub stats x`、`vpub comments`、`vpub messages` 和 `vpub dm`，見[功能範圍](FEATURES.md)）。不要將此交接流程本身宣傳為完整 X CLI。

## 自訂封面與訂閱

**免費瀏覽器路徑的自訂封面走需要訂閱權限的 Media Studio。** X 官方資料說明 Media Studio 僅向已驗證訂閱者開放，媒體庫的 Change thumbnail 可選影片影格或上傳圖片；圖片比例應與影片相同。一般發帖頁沒有同等保證，訂閱付款也不代表媒體庫已完成初始化。

[官方權限說明](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio) · [官方縮圖說明](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio-faqs)（查閱：2026-10-29）。

**訂閱級別** Media Studio 列於 Premium 與 Premium+，Basic 不包含。[官方訂閱比較](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-premium)。

**2026-10-29 後續實測** 原本媒體庫初始化失敗；直接點 Upload Media 上傳原片一次後，素材入庫並可開啟詳情。Change thumbnail → upload 上傳同為 16:9 的製作封面；關閉及重開後封面、標題、簡述保留。依使用者新增的明確授權再從 Studio 發布，已讀到新帖與原封面；舊帖保留。這是宿主 UI 實測，尚未整合為獨立 Studio API 或 CLI 封面回執命令。

流程：確認帳號與素材 → 上傳／選擇既有媒體 → Change thumbnail → 上傳與影片同比例的原封面 → 讀回 → 依授權 Post → 核對新作品連結。資料庫素材 ID 與帖文 ID 不相同；素材入庫不等於發布，也不會自動替換舊帖影片。

本次 Studio 新帖保留文案中的 AI-generated 聲明，但未觀察到一般發帖頁的 Made with AI 標記。不要把文案聲明當成已驗證的原生標記。完整播放與手機顯示仍需另行驗收。

相關連結：[官方來源](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos)

G.66 Technical Protocol & Record: publishops-crosscast/docs/X_GUIDE_EN.md

# X: CLI Media Studio publishing

[繁體中文](X_GUIDE.md) · **English**

**The free X browser publishing route requires a subscription and actual Media Studio access.** The official API route belongs to the separate paid add-on, which is not on sale yet; this does not establish support for free or Basic accounts.

This requirement exists because non-subscribers are limited to **140-second, 512 MB** video uploads and cannot use the Media Studio media-management and custom-thumbnail workflow on which the free browser route depends. CrossCast's free X browser backend uploads videos and sets production thumbnails through Media Studio, so that route supports subscription accounts with that access. Login or payment alone does not establish access; the CLI checks the library entry and managed account before selecting media. [Official upload limits](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos) · [Media Studio access](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio).

**0.3.1 alpha:** `vpub auth login x` opens the official login window once. Later `publish` commands reuse CrossCast's dedicated profile headlessly: check account → upload to Media Studio → apply the production thumbnail → fill exact source-aware post text → submit once → read back the original status. This is a scripted official website workflow, not an X API client. X may treat CrossCast's dedicated browser as a new device and ask for a check or account recovery: finish it yourself on X's own page; CrossCast never answers it.

```sh
vpub auth login x
vpub auth status x
vpub init --video final.mp4 --language zh-Hans --platforms x --out x.json
# Host prepares source-aware copy (English only, or original plus English) and the production cover.
vpub plan x.json
vpub publish x.json --confirm CURRENT_PLAN_HASH
vpub verify RECEIPT_KEY
vpub works x
```

Use `expected_identity` for the intended handle. Media Studio access is checked before upload, including the managed account identity. If processing or a selector fails before Post, `resume KEY` can reopen the same saved media; after Post it only verifies. A plan can set `existing_media_url` to a clip's own page in Media Studio, and it then posts that clip with no upload, provided the page's file has this video's `crosscast-<hash>` name. Existing receipts prevent another upload. `--draft-only` stops at preview, which is not a guaranteed persistent post draft. This route uses current account audience and does not alter protected-account settings.

Production cover upload and episode-two publication were observed; [validation](VALIDATION_EN.md) records the repairs and limits. Custom thumbnails require actual Media Studio access; a subscription alone is not a guarantee. Native AI-label control was not observed in Studio, so this route retains the explicit AI-generated caption disclosure.

## Eligibility and official limits

This project's free browser publishing route supports subscription accounts with actual Media Studio access. A free account's short-video allowance does not make it a supported publishing route here. X's general web-upload guide lists 140 seconds and 512 MB for non-subscribers; Studio thumbnail and media-management features require the appropriate access. [General upload limits](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos) · [Media Studio access](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio).

The official legacy tier table excludes Media Studio from Basic and includes it in Premium/Premium+. Other newer plans also exist; the actual account entitlement is decisive. Do not promise support for every paid plan. [Official tiers](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-premium). Checked 2026-10-30.

## Scheduling, folders and X's two websites

- **Scheduling.** Put a future `schedule` (an ISO time with an explicit time zone) in the X entry of the manifest. CrossCast fills Media Studio's own calendar and clock in this computer's time zone, reads them back and saves once. CrossCast reads Studio's schedule page once before the upload. Before its time, one new row there with exactly its words, its date and time and a video makes the receipt `SUBMISSION_VERIFIED` in phase `scheduled`. A row has no ID and doesn't say which video, and an identical row added by someone else after that first read would pass too. If a row like it was already there, or the first read couldn't tell, it stays `SUBMITTED_UNVERIFIED` until you look. After the time has passed, `vpub verify` confirms the post only from one new post with exactly its words, at about that time, showing the video Media Studio numbered; if that number cannot be read, it names the post as a `candidate_id` for you to check. On the one real post checked, a video with a custom cover showed no readable number, so this check would name a candidate rather than confirm. On a real account a post was scheduled this way and cancelled before its time; the row check was written from what that run saw and hasn't itself run there. No scheduled post has reached its time. To cancel one, open that page, hover over its row, press its Delete, then the red Delete. CrossCast has no command for this, and the clip stays in the Library until you delete it. The API route cannot schedule.
- **A cover on a vertical video.** On a real post a 3:4 cover was stored at 900×1200, but the public post shows it in the video's 9:16 frame, which clipped both edges of its title. Keep important words away from the edges. A landscape film's 16:9 cover hasn't been checked on its public post yet.
- **A video's length.** If the X entry of a plan has `duration_seconds`, CrossCast checks the file's video shows that length, within a second, before composing the post, and stops with `video_unverified` if it can't. Its picture size isn't checked, since a 1920×1080 film's preview played at 480×270.
- **Two websites.** X serves two versions of its website and CrossCast detects which one the account gets; so far a signed-in account gets the earlier one. A page that matches neither stops with an error; read that attempt's receipt (its `state`, `submitted_at` and `platform_writes`) to see whether anything had already gone out.
- **Bookmark folders** need X Premium. On the earlier site, listing, creating, renaming and deleting folders and adding a post to a folder were confirmed on a real account (a first add had gone in but was reported as unconfirmed, because CrossCast gave up waiting for X's answer; that wait is fixed). A post comes out of a folder through the share menu on the folder's own page; that worked by hand. Through CrossCast the first try ran out of time in the background browser before anything was recorded, and the second made one recorded press and ended unconfirmed, because the page showed no folder control when CrossCast went to read the result back (probably a page redraw; the control now gets a moment to come back). A later try through CrossCast was confirmed, with a separate read showing the folder empty.
- **Drafts.** `vpub init --draft-only` stops at the composer preview with the media saved in Media Studio (`PREVIEW_READY`); that is not a confirmed saved draft.

## Historical native-browser guide

The following records describe earlier host-operated tests; current CLI support is stated above.

[繁體中文](X_GUIDE.md) · **English**

This release provides **in-app-browser handoff**: sign-in URL, one post body, account checks, media snapshots, single submission and receipt validation. A host agent must operate the official site. One X publication has now been read back in the signed-in UI; a standalone API publisher and full-playback acceptance remain incomplete.

**Live test:** Ready media, English text and AI disclosure survived a saved-draft reopen. The user then explicitly authorized publication; the same draft was submitted and the original status read back. It was not deleted. Self-only tests must use draft-only mode, which forbids final submission until explicit authorization changes the mode.

```sh
vpub onboard --platforms x
vpub init --video final.mp4 --out x-publish.json --platforms x
# Review identity and text
vpub plan x-publish.json
vpub publish x-publish.json --confirm CURRENT_PLAN_HASH
```

Set `expected_identity` to the handle visible in the signed-in profile, without `@`. Confirm the account in the same browser before `browser begin`; let the user choose the sign-in method.

- **Text:** `plan.platforms.x.post_text` combines title, description and hashtags. `ai_generated: true` adds an AI disclosure. Use the complete generated `post_text` without silently rewriting or truncating it.
- **Audience:** Account/current UI audience applies; this is not an individual private-video switch and does not change protected-account settings.
- **Limits:** Check the website's weighted character counter, media validation and account limits; do not treat Python string length as X's counter. Inspect duration/size/format first, stop on mismatch, and do not silently trim or assume paid privileges.
- **Submit:** Wait for processing, check exact text/audience, submit once; inspect the original post after an uncertain result.
- **Receipt:** Read back the status URL, numeric ID, original handle, exact `post_text` and source fields. Validation rejects a different author, mismatched ID or altered disclosure/text.

X's web-upload guide currently lists 140 seconds and 512 MB for non-subscribers, with different paid limits; validate the actual account UI as well. [Official source](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-videos) (checked 2026-10-29).

This native handoff does not cover discovery, work listings, analytics, comments or the inbox; those are separate commands now (`vpub works x`, `vpub stats x`, `vpub comments`, `vpub messages` and `vpub dm`, see the [feature scope](FEATURES_EN.md)). Do not describe this handoff itself as a full X CLI.

## Custom thumbnails and subscription

**Custom thumbnails on the free browser route use subscription-gated Media Studio.** Official guidance limits Studio access to verified subscribers. Its library offers Change thumbnail with a video frame or uploaded image matching the video aspect ratio. Ordinary post composition is a different surface; payment alone does not prove that the library is ready.

[Official access](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio) · [Official thumbnail guidance](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/media-studio-faqs) (checked 2026-10-29).

**Tier:** Media Studio is included with Premium and Premium+, not Basic. [Official tier comparison](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/x-premium).

**Follow-up test, 2026-10-29:**

The library initially failed to initialize. A single direct Upload Media attempt succeeded and exposed media details. Change thumbnail → upload accepted the matching 16:9 production cover; artwork and metadata survived closing/reopening. Newly authorized Studio publication produced a new status with the original cover. The previous status was retained. This is host-UI validation, not a standalone Studio API or dedicated CLI cover-receipt command.

Workflow: verify account/media → upload or select existing media → Change thumbnail → upload same-ratio artwork → read back → Post when authorized → verify the status URL. Library media IDs differ from post IDs. Uploading media is not publication and does not replace an earlier post.

This Studio post retains the AI-generated text disclosure, but the native Made with AI badge was not observed. Text disclosure is not proof of the native label. Full playback and mobile presentation remain separate checks.
